summary_en: The segment reports that the Financial Regulatory Administration issued an action plan to strengthen governance of non-auto insurance lines, that China's trade with other APEC economies exceeded 18.03 trillion yuan in the first seven months of the year, that three typhoons are affecting southeastern coastal areas with heavy rain and disaster relief supplies were dispatched to Guangxi, that China's delegation to the 48th WorldSkills Competition has been formed, and that the 25th "Chinese Bridge" global finals for university students were held in Xiamen.

title_en: China's 16th Arctic Ocean Expedition Completes All Ice Station Surveys
summary_en: China's 16th Arctic Ocean expedition has completed all of its ice station surveys, with the icebreakers Xuelong and Xuelong 2 conducting multidisciplinary integrated surveys at 19 ice stations, including observations of the atmospheric boundary layer, sea ice physics, under-ice ecology and the under-ice ocean. The expedition established an unattended observation network in the Arctic Ocean, achieving a historic breakthrough in multi-point networked observations in the central Arctic region, and tested and operationally applied domestically produced advanced ocean observation equipment.

title_en: Second World Humanoid Robot Games Open in Beijing
summary_en: The Second World Humanoid Robot Games, co-hosted by the Beijing Municipal Government and China Media Group, opened in Beijing on the evening of August 22, with more than 2,000 humanoid robots competing over five days in 30 athletic events and 21 scenario-based contests. The segment reports that a robot ran the 100 meters in 9.39 seconds, surpassing the human world record of 9.58 seconds, and that robots also competed in events including the 400 meters, high jump, free combat, tennis and table tennis.

title_en: Domestic farm machinery debuts "new outfits"
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that domestically produced agricultural machinery is being upgraded and deployed to match practical needs, citing new corn harvesters in Jilin, electric tea pickers in Jiangsu, and smart duck-rearing sheds in Hebei, with over 7 billion yuan in cumulative central fiscal spending to advance work on weak-link equipment.

title_en: China's Mine Ecological Protection and Restoration Moves Toward Green and New Development
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that China's 262 resource-based cities are advancing the green transformation of mining, with 699 national-level green mines now built, accounting for 67.7% of the national total, and 88 national industrial heritage sites in resource-based cities, 33% of the national total. The National Development and Reform Commission said it will integrate mine ecological restoration with the cultivation of replacement industries and urban renewal, improve ecological compensation and investment and financing mechanisms, and accelerate a virtuous cycle of "treatment—value-added—feedback."

title_en: Multiple Commercial Banks Publish Optimized Implementation Plans for Consumer Loan Interest Subsidy Policy
summary_en: Several Chinese commercial banks, including ICBC and Agricultural Bank of China, announced that starting August 1 the annual interest subsidy cap per borrower for personal consumer loans and credit card installment business at a single bank will rise from 3,000 yuan to 5,000 yuan, with credit card subsidy coverage expanded to auto, home renovation and other specialized installments at an annualized rate of 1 percentage point, capped at 50% of the agreed annualized rate. The banks said no separate application is needed, no service fees are charged, and the expanded subsidies aim to lower consumer credit costs and reinforce consumption-boosting policies such as trade-in programs.

title_en: China's E-commerce Achieves Steady, Innovative Development from January to July
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports, citing the Ministry of Commerce, that China's e-commerce grew steadily and innovatively in the first seven months of the year, with national online retail sales of goods and services up 4.8% year-on-year and contributing over half of the growth in total retail sales of goods and services. The segment also notes strong growth in online travel and lifestyle services and in e-commerce for agricultural and industrial products.

title_en: Qinghai: Improving the ecological protection and restoration system to fortify the 'China Water Tower' ecological barrier
summary_en: CCTV reports that Qinghai, source of the Yellow, Yangtze and Lancang rivers, is pursuing integrated protection and systematic management of mountains, rivers, forests, farmland, lakes, grasslands and sand in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, including grassland restoration at high altitude, native grass seed breeding, expanded sky-ground integrated ecological monitoring, and training for more than 20,000 herder ecological stewards. The province has released a 2026-2035 plan for the Sanjiangyuan 'China Water Tower' ecological protection support system with 52 key tasks and 37 major projects, and aims to restore 300,000 mu in the Qinghai Lake basin and upper Lancang River.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Making Good Use of Red Resources and Carrying Forward the Red Bloodline
summary_en: The segment reports that, guided by Xi Jinping's instructions on protecting and utilizing "red resources" (revolutionary heritage sites and relics), localities are improving protection mechanisms and drawing on revolutionary history; it notes a summer surge in visits to the Long March National Cultural Park across 15 provinces, cites figures on immovable revolutionary relics, state-held revolutionary artifacts and more than 3,000 revolutionary memorial halls, and describes new preservation guidelines and regional exhibition efforts in places such as Beijing and Chongqing.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Palestinian President Abbas and eight foreign ministers condemned Israel's advancement of the E1 settlement plan in the West Bank, while the Palestinian Health Ministry reported two Palestinians killed in settler-related violence; Russia said it struck Ukrainian railway and logistics facilities near Kyiv, and Germany's gas storage level fell to its lowest on record for the date at 49%.

title_en: Canada Announces Suspension of Trade Talks with US and Implements Reciprocal Countermeasures
summary_en: Canadian Prime Minister Carney announced late on the 21st that Canada is suspending trade negotiations with the United States and recalling its negotiating delegation, saying the US's last-minute revised terms were "unfair and illogical." US Trade Representative Greer said that because Canada refused to reach an agreement, the US will impose a 50% tariff on about $20 billion of Canadian imports starting the 22nd, to which Canada said it will apply reciprocal counter-tariffs.

title_en: Iran Says It Will Continue Strengthening Defense Forces to Counter Threats; US Says It Will Not Abandon Military Option Against Iran
summary_en: On Iran's Defense Industry Day, Iranian Armed Forces Chief of Staff Abdolrahim Mousavi, IRGC Commander Ahmad Vahidi, and acting Defense Minister Ebn al-Reza said Iran's defense industry has made major progress and that Iran will keep strengthening its defenses and respond forcefully to any enemy threats. US President Donald Trump said the shift to "economic war" does not limit US military options against Iran, while Omani Foreign Minister Badr al-Busaidi and Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi discussed by phone restoring free navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's total electricity consumption rose 1.7% year-on-year in July to 1.04 trillion kWh, that imports from over 150 trading partners grew in the first seven months of the year, and that the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission issued a 2026-2030 action plan for high-quality development of cyberspace and information technology enterprises. It also covers Shanghai Lingang's 15th Five-Year Plan targets, a nationwide rollout of a pilot service for querying deceased persons' financial accounts, heavy rain warnings in southern China from Typhoon Zitan and the monsoon, the close of the third UN dialogue on AI and human development in Xi'an, overseas box-office performance of Chinese films, and an exhibition on Guangzhou's urban history.

title_en: [Cultural China Tour] Preserving Foguang Temple's "Millennium Gaze"
summary_en: The segment reports on efforts to protect the cultural landscape of Foguang Temple in Wutai County, Shanxi, home to China's highest-ranking surviving Tang dynasty wooden structure, including the rerouting of the Fanshi-Wutai expressway around the temple in 2023-2024 and a 2025 local regulation expanding the protected visual landscape to about 84 square kilometers.

title_en: China Achieves Independent Mass Production of High-End Steel in Multiple Fields
summary_en: The segment reports that Chinese steel enterprises have achieved breakthroughs in core technologies and independent mass production of high-end specialty steels, including a 0.07mm-thick "cicada-wing steel" used in integrated circuit substrates and 5G base stations, and low-expansion specialty steel for aerospace composite molds, with three Chinese steel firms named to the global "Lighthouse Factory" list.

title_en: High-tech industries attract 32.7% more foreign investment year-on-year in January-July
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports, citing the Ministry of Commerce, that China used 438.33 billion yuan in actual foreign investment in January-July, with more than 37,000 new foreign-invested enterprises established, up 4.4% year-on-year. Actual foreign investment in high-tech industries reached 182.31 billion yuan, up 32.7% year-on-year and accounting for 41.6% of the national total, while investment from Saudi Arabia, France and South Korea grew 343.7%, 36.1% and 15.8% respectively.

title_en: Shandong Builds Commercial Space Industry Hub, Aiming for Strong Start to 15th Five-Year Plan
summary_en: Shandong is developing a commercial space industry hub centered on the Dongfang Spaceport in Yantai, China's only commercial sea-launch base, supported by provincial coordination and policies; the province has signed projects worth 63.5 billion yuan and aims by 2027 to produce 100 launch vehicles and 150 commercial satellites annually, with the industry scale reaching 50 billion yuan.

title_en: Communiqué of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China
summary_en: The Sixth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection concluded in Beijing on August 22, 2026, with 116 commission members attending and CCDI Secretary Li Xi delivering a speech. The session reviewed anti-corruption and discipline work in the first half of 2026, set requirements for the next stage, and elected Zhao Shiyong as a deputy secretary of the CCDI and Zhang Zhong as a member of its Standing Committee and deputy secretary.

title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: Expanding New Space for Belt and Road Cooperation, Paving a Road to Win-Win
summary_en: The segment reports on progress in high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, citing Xi Jinping's remarks on mutual benefit and noting that over 150 countries and more than 30 international organizations have joined the initiative; it highlights Chinese smart early-warning systems used by Chilean power companies, record China-Europe freight train volumes (12,988 trains in the first seven months, up 17.6% year-on-year), and growth in exports of "new three" products (482.24 billion yuan, up 59.8%) and imports (up 16.9%) with Belt and Road partner countries.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that seven countries—Britain, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway and Canada—issued a joint statement condemning Israel's advancement of the E1 settlement construction plan; that Yemen's Houthi forces claimed drone attacks on an airport and an Aramco oil facility in Saudi Arabia's Najran region; and that the European Commission said it wants all migrants who illegally entered the Spanish enclave of Ceuta to return to Morocco.

title_en: Wildfires persist in Spain and other countries amid high temperatures and drought
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): Wildfires have broken out and continued to spread in western Spain amid high temperatures and drought, forcing hundreds of people to evacuate as of the 20th. Serbian media reported that a wildfire broke out about 60 kilometers east of the capital Belgrade, and Serbia has requested assistance from other countries due to the severity of the fire. Germany's central bank, the Deutsche Bundesbank, said in its monthly report on the 20th that the recent sustained drought has lowered water levels and reduced navigability on rivers such as the Rhine, and that the ongoing drought may drag down Germany's economic recovery in the third quarter.

title_en: Iran Condemns New US Sanctions as 'Economic Terrorism'
summary_en: Iran's Foreign Ministry issued a statement strongly condemning new US economic and trade sanctions against Iran, calling them "economic terrorism" and a violation of international law, while the US said it would intensify economic pressure and the USS George Washington carrier strike group arrived in the Middle East to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln.

title_en: Russian Foreign Ministry: Japan Should Fully Acknowledge the Results of World War II and Stop Distorting Its History of Aggression
summary_en: Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Zakharova stated on the 20th that Japan should acknowledge and reflect on its history of aggression during World War II and stop "whitewashing" its wartime crimes.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Export-Import Bank of China issued nearly 500 billion yuan in new manufacturing loans in the first seven months of the year, that the Ministry of Finance issued 6 billion yuan in RMB-denominated government bonds in Macao, and that regulators announced progress on personal information protection, quality-strengthening supply chain projects, APEC agricultural and customs agreements, data cooperation pilots, and the delivery of a domestically developed 115,000-tonne product tanker. It also notes that CCTV's High-Level Interview will air an exclusive interview with UN Deputy Secretary-General and UNCCD Executive Secretary Yasmin Fouad.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Meeting with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a 'Strivers on the New Journey' meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on August 21, at which five representatives from the natural resources field discussed 'protecting natural resources and building a beautiful China,' sharing stories of their work in surveying and mapping technology, geological disaster prevention, deep-sea submersibles, farmland protection, and desertification control.

title_en: Sports Events Spark New Vitality in Economic Development
summary_en: The segment reports that sporting events, from city leagues to rural competitions, are boosting participation in sports while driving local consumption and tourism. It highlights the 2026 "Village Super League" finals in Rongjiang, Guizhou, which drew over 5 million visitors and 5.255 billion yuan in tourism spending in half a year, and Jiangsu's "Su Super" league, which attracted over 1.85 million spectators and helped generate 9.59 billion yuan in sales at monitored retail and trade enterprises.

title_en: Vital China Research Tour: AI Speeds Up Scientific Innovation
summary_en: The segment reports on Anhui province's new AI-powered platform, built on a large model developed by the University of Science and Technology of China, that helps researchers discover new materials; a team used it to develop a fire-resistant material for firefighter suits in under four months, extending protection from about ten seconds to half an hour, and the platform is open to scientists worldwide.

title_en: China's Early Rice Output Stable Above 56 Billion Jin for Sixth Consecutive Year
summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics reported on August 21 that China's 2026 early rice output reached 56.58 billion jin, remaining above 56 billion jin for a sixth straight year, with yield of 397.6 kg per mu. Output rose in Anhui, Fujian and Hubei, while the four main producing regions of Guangxi, Hunan, Guangdong and Jiangxi saw declines due to extreme weather such as typhoons; sown area totaled 71.164 million mu, up 22,000 mu from the previous year.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: Proactive Fiscal Policy Boosts High-Quality Economic and Social Development
summary_en: At an August 21 State Council Information Office press conference, a Ministry of Finance official said China is implementing a more proactive fiscal policy this year, with budgeted fiscal spending exceeding 30 trillion yuan for the first time, new government bonds totaling 11.89 trillion yuan, and central-to-local transfer payments reaching 10.42 trillion yuan, while 12.4 trillion yuan is allocated for education, social security, health care and housing and about 100 billion yuan in subsidies supports childcare allowances.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets with King Abdullah II of Jordan
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met with Jordan's King Abdullah II in Beijing on the morning of August 21, with both sides pledging to deepen political trust, practical cooperation, and exchanges between their legislatures. Earlier that morning, King Abdullah II laid a wreath at the Monument to the People's Heroes in Tiananmen Square.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on August 21 that heard a report on building next-generation communications networks, deployed further efforts to clear overdue payments owed to enterprises, and studied continued work to improve air quality. The meeting also reviewed and approved revised regulations on emergency response and investigation of electric power safety accidents and draft regulations on market supervision offices.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Undaunted by Wind and Waves, China's High-Quality Economic Development Advances Steadily and Far
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, China's economy grew 4.7% year-on-year in the first half, with the IMF raising its forecast for China by 0.2 percentage points, as Beijing emphasizes coordinating development and security under Xi Jinping's leadership amid a complex international environment and disruptions to energy shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Russia's Pacific Fleet conducted a planned exercise with missile strikes on targets near the disputed South Kuril Islands, that Germany announced another suspect was arrested in Croatia over the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline explosions, that Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf met Iraqi leaders in Baghdad to discuss deepening cooperation, that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned Turkey against establishing a military foothold in Syria while Turkey called for action against Israeli aggression, and that NASA canceled a mission to boost the orbit of the Swift observatory due to a technical problem with the rescue spacecraft.

title_en: US federal government debt exceeds $40 trillion for the first time; US media say US structural crisis is worsening
summary_en: Citing US Treasury data released on the 19th, the segment reports that total US federal government debt reached about $40.05 trillion, surpassing $40 trillion for the first time, and notes US media coverage saying the debt has more than doubled in under a decade and that the milestone signals a worsening structural crisis with accumulating risks. It also cites experts saying the debt surge, rising interest rates and related political deadlock are eroding US economic resilience, that huge interest payments are diverting public fiscal resources, and that the endless expansion of US debt is undermining global investors' confidence in its long-term credit.

title_en: US President Says Devastating Economic Action Taken Against Iran; Iran Says Hostile Ships Barred from Strait of Hormuz
summary_en: US President Trump announced on August 19 that the United States is carrying out what he called the most devastating economic action in history against Iran, an unprecedented economic war and isolation campaign that he said requires all allies to participate. Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi said on August 20 that the US economic action is intended to distract attention from domestic crises including unprecedented debt and rising interest costs, while Iran's parliamentary national security committee said hostile ships or those threatening Iran's national security are barred from the Strait of Hormuz, and Axios reported that the US military has covertly established a shipping corridor to ensure millions of barrels of oil leave the strait daily.

title_en: Japanese citizens protest dangerous moves by Takaichi administration, say it is pushing the country to the brink of war
summary_en: On the evening of the 19th, a number of Japanese citizens held a protest rally in front of the National Diet building in Tokyo, criticizing a series of dangerous moves by the Takaichi administration that they say are pushing the country to the brink of war, and expressing strong opposition.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the All-China Federation of Trade Unions released its 15th Five-Year Plan for industrial workforce reform, alongside plans to keep basic medical insurance coverage at about 95 percent, a new "AI plus transportation" initiative, a Supreme People's Court revision of copyright judicial interpretations, and expanded 240-hour visa-free transit to 57 countries. It also covers the seventh China-Africa Media Cooperation Forum in Beijing and the recording of over 100 white-lipped deer crossing the Yalong River in Sichuan's Shiqu County.

title_en: Harvest Season: Specialty Agricultural Products Help Farmers Increase Income
summary_en: The segment reports on autumn harvests of specialty crops across China boosting farmer incomes, including red-fleshed kiwifruit in Liupanshui, Guizhou, where drones are now used to transport fruit, and grapes in Fu'an, Fujian, handled through digitized management and cold-chain logistics. It also covers fishing ports in Beihai, Guangxi, and Zhapo, Guangdong, where boats have returned with abundant catches sold online and shipped nationwide by air freight.

title_en: New Growth Drivers Continue to Strengthen Their Contribution to China's Industrial Economy
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that in January–July, new growth drivers such as high-tech manufacturing and digital product manufacturing contributed about 50% of the growth in value-added of industrial enterprises above designated size, roughly 3 percentage points more than in the first half of the year, with rapid output growth in AI-related sensors, memory chips and optical fiber, and notably faster growth in integrated circuit, aircraft and smart equipment manufacturing; Anhui's integrated circuit industry grew more than threefold year on year. In July, industrial goods exports maintained double-digit growth, with export delivery values in the automotive and electronics sectors rising 41.2% and 8.4% respectively and contributing 25.8% and 30.7% of the total increase.

title_en: Major Projects Across China Advance Steadily
summary_en: The segment reports steady progress on major infrastructure projects nationwide, including the completion of the main structure of the Huaifu hub on the Huai River sea-outlet channel in Yancheng, Jiangsu; trial runs on the Xi'an–Ankang high-speed rail in Shaanxi; and the launch of the second phase of a 200,000-ton green methanol project in Taonan, Jilin, alongside progress on the Gansu–Zhejiang ultra-high-voltage transmission line.

title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with President of El Salvador's Legislative Assembly
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji held talks in Beijing with Ernesto Castro, President of El Salvador's Legislative Assembly, on the eve of the 8th anniversary of China-El Salvador diplomatic relations, with both sides pledging to deepen political trust, economic and cultural cooperation, and exchanges between their legislatures.

title_en: CPC Central Committee, State Council and Central Military Commission Issue Decision Awarding Zhang Lu the "Second-Class Space Merit Medal" and Conferring the "Heroic Astronaut" Honorary Title on Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang with the "Third-Class Space Merit Medal"
summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, State Council and Central Military Commission issued a decision awarding astronaut Zhang Lu the Second-Class Space Merit Medal and conferring the "Heroic Astronaut" title on Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang along with the Third-Class Space Merit Medal, honoring the Shenzhou-21 crew for their seven-month mission, three spacewalks and more than 110 station maintenance tasks before their safe return on May 29, 2026.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Quality Medical Resources Sink to the Grassroots to Benefit the People, Painting a New Picture of a Healthy China
summary_en: The segment reports on the Communist Party's push under Xi Jinping to shift quality medical resources from cities to grassroots and rural areas, citing the 2016 National Health Conference, the Healthy China 2030 outline, and progress such as over 80% of counties having built shared imaging, ECG and testing centers serving more than 330 million patient visits, and 1.391 million family doctors by the end of 2025.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Hakainde Hichilema on His Reelection as Zambian President
summary_en: On August 20, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Hakainde Hichilema congratulating him on his reelection as President of the Republic of Zambia. Xi noted their two meetings in recent years and said he is willing to work with President Hichilema to implement the outcomes of the Beijing Summit of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation and further advance the China-Zambia comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Israeli airstrikes on an air base in Syria's Idlib province, which Syria's transitional government condemned as unjustified aggression, along with Turkish and U.S. reactions; the DRC's confirmed Ebola cases surpassing 5,000 with 2,378 deaths as the WHO maintains a public health emergency of international concern; and explosions at an Ohio industrial recycling facility and at natural gasoline storage tanks in Oklahoma.

title_en: US President Says No Talks with Iran; Iran Says Strait of Hormuz to Remain Closed Until US Meets Conditions
summary_en: US President Donald Trump said on the 18th that the US naval blockade of Iran remains fully in effect and that Washington will not hold any talks or dialogue with Iran now or in the future, while Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf said the Strait of Hormuz will stay closed until the US meets the conditions of the memorandum of understanding, including lifting the blockade and sanctions and unfreezing Iranian assets. The segment also reports that the 60-day window for a final US-Iran agreement has passed without a breakthrough, and that the US 30-year Treasury yield reached 5.31% on the 17th, a 19-year high.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment covers a joint release by the Central Propaganda Department and National Health Commission of the "Most Beautiful Doctors" advanced deeds, honoring nine medical workers, along with reports on 122 large and medium-sized irrigation districts, the first global international standard for smart manufacturing in the steel industry led by China, the 2026 World Robot Conference, the 33rd Beijing International Radio, TV and Film Exhibition, a children's choral performance in Shenyang, and CCTV's 2026 financial programming and Qixi Festival gala.

title_en: 2026 Summer Movie Season Sets New Records for Screenings and Attendance; Film Industry Chain Output Value Exceeds 410 Billion Yuan
summary_en: CCTV reports that 2026 summer movie attendance has surpassed 290 million and screenings have exceeded 34.5 million, both record highs, with the new film "Welcome to Dragon Restaurant" earning nearly 1.2 billion yuan in nine days and summer box office topping 10.6 billion yuan. The segment also notes that subsidized ticket programs have pushed average ticket prices to a five-year low and that the film industry chain's total output value has exceeded 410 billion yuan this year.

title_en: China to Build Approximately 60,000 Kilometers of Premium Self-Drive Tourism Highways
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports, citing the Ministry of Transport, that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period China will accelerate development of a premium self-drive tourism highway system, built mainly on ordinary national highways and linking national cultural parks, core tourism resources, and distinctive landscapes, forming a roughly 60,000-kilometer main framework of "three rings, four horizontals, and five verticals." The three rings comprise the border-coastal loop, the capital metropolitan area loop, and the Qinghai-Gansu loop; the four horizontals cover Great Wall culture, Yellow River culture, Yangtze River culture, and the western snow-region sky road; and the five verticals cover Grand Canal culture, East China world heritage sites, central China's scenic mountains, Long March culture, and ancient trail routes.

title_en: Localities Strengthen Field Management to Consolidate Foundation for Grain Harvest
summary_en: The segment reports that localities across China are seizing the farming season to carry out refined field management for autumn grain crops, including smart irrigation in Heilongjiang, pest control in Hebei, new fertilization technology in Chongqing's Liangping, post-rainfall expert guidance in Henan, field care in Anhui's Xiaogang Village, and machinery deployment for drainage and replanting in Guangxi's Hengzhou.

title_en: Service Sector Expands Capacity and Quality, Helping Chinese Manufacturing Boost Global Competitiveness
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's service sector has continued to expand capacity and improve quality this year, with producer services moving toward higher value-added segments and increasingly accompanying Chinese manufacturing abroad; in the first seven months, the production index for information transmission, software and IT services grew 10.6% year-on-year, and knowledge-intensive services such as software, IT and professional consulting accounted for more than half of service exports.

title_en: Chang'e-7 Spacecraft-Rocket Combination Completes Vertical Transfer
summary_en: At the Wenchang Space Launch Site in Hainan, the Chang'e-7 probe and its Long March 5 Y14 carrier rocket were transferred vertically to the launch area in light-to-moderate rain, demonstrating the rocket's ability to transfer and launch in such weather. The Chang'e-7 mission, which includes an orbiter, lander, rover and hopper along with the Queqiao-2 relay satellite, aims to survey the lunar south pole's environment and resources and is scheduled for launch in the coming days.

title_en: China Achieves First Land-Based Rocket Recovery
summary_en: On August 19, the Zhuque-3 Y2 rocket lifted off from the Dongfeng Commercial Space Innovation Test Zone, placing the Honghu-03 satellite into its planned orbit, while its first stage completed China's first controlled land-based recovery using landing legs, marking another major breakthrough in reusable rocket technology. The Zhuque-3, a next-generation reusable liquid oxygen-methane rocket developed by LandSpace under a project approved by the China National Space Administration, is 66.1 meters long with a takeoff weight of 570 tons.

title_en: Establishing and Practicing a Correct View of Political Achievements: Promoting Learning Through Action, Ensuring Learning and Education Deliver Results
summary_en: Shenzhen and Shihezi (Eighth Division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps) are deepening education on establishing a correct view of political achievements, combining study, inspection and rectification to address public concerns; Shenzhen has launched tiered AI training courses at public welfare night schools for young people and identified over 10,000 issues for rectification, while Shihezi has resolved more than 3,500 livelihood matters, including reorganizing a night market to reduce noise and fumes affecting nearby residents.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets Ecuadorian President Noboa
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa in Beijing on the morning of August 19, following Xi Jinping's talks with Noboa the previous day. Zhao said China's NPC is ready to strengthen exchanges with Ecuador's National Assembly, while Noboa called China a good friend and partner and expressed support for China's sovereignty and territorial integrity.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Ecuadorian President
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing on the 19th with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa, who is on a state visit to China. Li noted that this year marks the 10th anniversary of the China-Ecuador comprehensive strategic partnership and said China is willing to deepen cooperation with Ecuador in energy, minerals, trade, and livelihood areas, while Noboa said China is an important partner and good friend of Ecuador and that Ecuador is ready to further tap the benefits of the bilateral free trade agreement.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Building Higher-Standard Pilot Free Trade Zones to Create New Heights of Reform and Opening Up
summary_en: The segment reports on China's 23 pilot free trade zones, which cover less than 0.4 percent of the country's land area but account for over a quarter of foreign investment and a fifth of total imports and exports, and highlights new measures such as expanded offshore trade financial reform in Shanghai's Lin-gang Special Area, a data export negative list in Beijing, expanded zero-tariff coverage in Hainan, and bonded aircraft maintenance in Xiamen.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Sulyok on Assuming Office as President of Hungary
summary_en: On August 19, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Tamás Sulyok congratulating him on becoming President of Hungary, noting the two countries' traditional friendship and 77 years of diplomatic ties and expressing willingness to work with President Sulyok to deepen political mutual trust and practical cooperation and advance the China-Hungary all-weather comprehensive strategic partnership for the new era.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that U.S. President Trump's special envoy Jared Kushner met with new Hamas political bureau chief Yahya Sinwar and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with limited progress on a Gaza peace plan; that Russia warned Britain over Ukraine's use of British-made drones to strike deep inside Russia; and that over 220,000 Canadians signed a petition demanding the expulsion of U.S. Ambassador to Canada Pete Hoekstra over alleged interference in Canadian affairs.

title_en: US Says It Will Not Extend Memorandum of Understanding; Iran Says It Will Not Accept Ultimatums
summary_en: US President Donald Trump said on the 17th that the United States does not plan to extend its memorandum of understanding with Iran and that the US is fully controlling the Strait of Hormuz through a blockade, warning that the US would attack Oman if it obstructed efforts to reopen the strait. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said on the 17th that Iran would never adjust its policies under "pressure, ultimatums or time limits," and that because the US had seriously violated the memorandum of understanding, no dialogue had taken place between the two sides.

title_en: Russian Foreign Minister Criticizes Japan for Using Attacks on Russia to Conceal Aggressive Military Moves
summary_en: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said on the 17th that Japan was trying to use its criticism of Russia to conceal its own aggressive military moves, commenting on Japan's protest over President Vladimir Putin's visit to Iturup Island (which Japan calls Etorofu). Russia's Foreign Ministry had summoned Japanese Ambassador to Russia Mutsu Hitoshi over Japan's response to Putin's visit, and the Japanese embassy subsequently said the ambassador was unwell and unable to accept the summons.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports a roundup of domestic news: two ministries allocated another 60 million yuan for flood relief in Henan; the cross-border cash pool policy for multinational companies was extended nationwide; medical insurance instant settlement targets were met ahead of schedule; 72 products in six categories were added to green building materials certification; Hengqin Port's new passenger inspection area surpassed 110 million passenger trips; Unit 7 of the Tianwan nuclear plant entered nuclear commissioning; the Qitai radio telescope in Xinjiang completed core structure installation; a 99,000-cubic-meter ethane/ethylene carrier was delivered; and the National Climate Center warned that El Niño is developing rapidly and will likely become the strongest on record.

title_en: 2025 South China Sea Region Marine Ecological Conditions Generally Stable
summary_en: China's Ministry of Natural Resources South China Sea Bureau released the 2025 South China Sea Region Marine Ecological Early-Warning Monitoring Bulletin and the 2025 South China Sea Region Marine Ecological Protection and Restoration Bulletin, reporting that marine ecological conditions in the region were generally stable in 2025, with mangrove and seagrass ecosystems in good overall condition and the first integrated assessment of the ecological conditions of the Xisha, Zhongsha and Nansha island reefs. The restoration bulletin reported 66 marine ecological restoration projects implemented in 2025 with total investment of nearly 5 billion yuan, and by the end of 2025 roughly 2.66 million hectares designated as marine ecological protection red lines and about 7 million hectares as marine nature reserves.

title_en: Macao SAR Government Officially Releases Third Five-Year Plan
summary_en: The Macao Special Administrative Region government officially released its Third Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development (2026-2030), setting 35 main economic and social development indicators and eight major development goals, including fully implementing the overall national security concept, further improving governance effectiveness under the law, achieving substantive new progress in appropriately diversified economic development, and high-quality advancement of the Hengqin cooperation zone. Macao SAR Chief Executive Sam Hou Fai said the plan is a roadmap and task list for Macao's new stage of high-quality development and an important innovative measure for deepening the practice of "One Country, Two Systems" and integrating into and serving the country's overall development.

title_en: Yangtze River Delta Foreign Trade Hits Record High as 'New Drivers' Lead High-Quality Development
summary_en: Customs data show that in the first seven months of the year, goods trade imports and exports in the Yangtze River Delta reached a record high for the period, totaling 11.41 trillion yuan, up 18.9% year-on-year and accounting for 37.9% of China's total, with high-tech products such as integrated circuits and high-end equipment driving growth. Shanghai's foreign trade exceeded 3 trillion yuan for the first time, with trade with Belt and Road partner countries up more than 40%, while Anhui led the region with 35.7% growth and ranked first nationwide in automobile export volume and value.

title_en: China to Accelerate Building of a Modern Oil and Gas Industry System During the 15th Five-Year Plan
summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration jointly released the "Oil and Gas Development 15th Five-Year Plan," which calls for safeguarding energy security, steadily advancing green transition, expanding oil and gas exploration and development, and pushing marine oil and gas output to the 100-million-ton scale. By 2030, domestic oil and gas supply is targeted to reach 440 million tons of oil equivalent, with 20,000 kilometers of new long-distance pipelines added to bring the national network to 220,000 kilometers, gradually establishing an autonomous, controllable, green and low-carbon modern oil and gas industry system.

title_en: Multiple Measures to Further Energize Lower-Tier Markets
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on August 18, officials presented the Opinions on Further Energizing Lower-Tier Markets and Boosting County-Level Consumption, which focuses on county areas and offline consumption and sets out measures to upgrade commercial facilities, improve goods and services supply including elderly and child care, strengthen urban-rural distribution networks, and support company headquarters and platform firms in locating in counties to create jobs.

title_en: Zhao Leji Chairs 71st Council of Chairpersons Meeting of 14th NPC Standing Committee; Decides 24th Session of 14th NPC Standing Committee to Be Held in Beijing August 25-28
summary_en: Zhao Leji chaired the 71st meeting of the Council of Chairpersons of the 14th NPC Standing Committee at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, which decided that the 24th session of the Standing Committee will be held in Beijing from August 25 to 28. The proposed agenda includes deliberation of draft laws on medical security, farmland protection and quality improvement, revisions to the agriculture law, national defense mobilization law, lawyers law, enterprise bankruptcy law, banking supervision law, and water law, as well as State Council bills including a road traffic safety law revision and approval of the China-Hungary extradition treaty, along with reports on economic and social development plans, budget execution, government debt management, cultural products and services, and rural revitalization.

title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree Promulgating Decision to Amend Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree promulgating a 20-article decision amending the Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management, effective September 20, 2026, which broadens the scope for withdrawing and using provident funds, simplifies procedures and enables nationwide mutual recognition of contribution records, strengthens credit record-keeping and risk controls, and extends voluntary participation to self-employed and other flexible workers.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Ecuadorian President
summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, President Xi Jinping held talks at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa, who was on a state visit to China, marking the 10th anniversary of the two countries' comprehensive strategic partnership. The two leaders witnessed the signing of cooperation documents in areas including green industry, trade, the digital economy and livelihoods, and Xi hosted a welcome ceremony and banquet for Noboa.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Ceremony to Welcome Ecuadorian President on Visit to China
summary_en: President Xi Jinping held a welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People on the afternoon of the 18th for Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa, who is making a state visit to China at Xi's invitation. The ceremony included a 21-gun salute in Tiananmen Square, the playing of both national anthems, and a review of the PLA honor guard, with Foreign Minister Wang Yi and other officials in attendance.

title_en: Comrade Zhu Rongji's body cremated in Beijing
summary_en: The body of Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council and member of the 14th and 15th CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committees, was cremated at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing on the 18th after his death on August 12, 2026, at age 98. Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi and Han Zheng attended the farewell, while Hu Jintao sent a wreath to express condolences.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that US President Trump said he asked the Pentagon to sharply scale back joint US-South Korea military exercises, that the foreign ministers of eight countries condemned Israel's rejection of a Gaza peace plan, and that Ebola deaths in the DRC, wildfires on a Greek island near Athens, and flooding and power outages in Hawaii caused by Hurricane Lane were also covered.

title_en: Russia says it downed over 1,400 drones in a day; Ukraine strikes Russian logistics hub
summary_en: Russia's Defense Ministry said on the 16th that Russian forces downed 1,478 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones over the past 24 hours, a single-day record according to Russian media, while continuing strikes on Ukrainian port facilities and drone production sites. Ukraine's Defense Ministry said on the 16th that Ukrainian forces launched a large-scale drone attack on a logistics hub of the Russian e-commerce platform Wildberries in Moscow Region, with 7 of the company's 10 large warehouses reportedly halted.

title_en: Iran Says US and Israel Achieved No Goals in War on Iran
summary_en: Iranian officials, including Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf and President Masoud Pezeshkian, said the US and Israel failed to achieve any objectives in their war on Iran and that Iran did not yield to the enemy, while army commander Amir Hatami said US forces had been expelled from the Persian Gulf, Gulf of Oman and Strait of Hormuz. US media also reported growing frustration among Gulf allies, including Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar, over Washington's lack of diplomatic capacity to reach a peace deal with Iran.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that new home prices in first-tier cities rose month-on-month in July, that eight government departments issued a joint notice to safeguard agricultural irrigation water, that China designated its first batch of 158 primary-care diseases under a "same disease, same payment" hospital payment policy, that Chang'e-6 lunar soil research offers new evidence on differences between the Moon's near and far sides, and that the TV drama "Cang Feng" premieres tonight on CCTV's main channel.

title_en: National Economy Stable Overall in January-July, Developing Toward New and Better
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on August 17 where the National Bureau of Statistics spokesperson presented July economic data, reporting that the national economy remained generally stable and trended toward new and improved development in January-July. Industrial output above designated size grew 5.3% year-on-year, with equipment manufacturing up 9.7% and high-tech manufacturing up 13.8%, while services, consumption, and energy production also showed steady growth.

title_en: Seminar on Jiang Zemin's Life and Thought Held in Beijing; Cai Qi Attends Opening Ceremony and Delivers Speech
summary_en: A seminar on Jiang Zemin's life and thought was held in Beijing from the 17th to the 19th, with Politburo Standing Committee member and Secretariat head Cai Qi attending the opening ceremony and delivering a speech. Cai called for deeper study of the "Three Represents" important thought in light of new era conditions, and Li Shulei presided over the meeting, with Shi Taifeng, Liu Guozhong, Zhang Shengmin, Qu Qingshan and Xin Changxing also speaking.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs the 12th Plenary Meeting of the State Council
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired the 12th Plenary Meeting of the State Council on August 17, calling for implementing the spirit of Xi Jinping's important speech on the current economic situation and economic work, and stressing efforts to meet the year's economic and social development targets and achieve a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan. Li cited generally stable economic performance with new growth drivers and improved structure, while noting prominent insufficient domestic demand and growing difficulties for some industries and enterprises, and urged full use of existing policies alongside timely new practical measures.

title_en: At Xi Jinping's invitation, King of Jordan to pay state visit to China
summary_en: At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, King Abdullah II of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan will pay a state visit to China from August 18 to 24.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Message of Condolence to Indonesian President Over Strong Earthquake in Indonesia
summary_en: On August 17, President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto over the strong earthquake in Indonesia, expressing condolences for the victims and sympathy to the bereaved families and the injured on behalf of the Chinese government and people, and expressing confidence that under the leadership of the Indonesian government led by Prabowo, the Indonesian people will overcome the disaster and rebuild their homes at an early date.

title_en: Grand gathering held in Beijing to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth; Xi Jinping delivers important speech
summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council, CPPCC National Committee and Central Military Commission held a grand gathering at the Great Hall of the People to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the birth of Jiang Zemin, with Xi Jinping delivering an important speech praising Jiang's contributions and calling for learning from his political faith, commitment to the people, innovative spirit, strategic thinking and courage. Premier Li Qiang presided over the meeting, which was attended by about 6,000 people including senior leaders and retired officials.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Russia has formally demanded explanations from the US and Turkey over a planned transfer of US-made weapons to Ukraine, that the death toll from a strong earthquake near Indonesia's Flores Island has risen to 51, that Spain has reinforced deployments in Ceuta to prevent illegal crossings, and that wildfires have reignited in southern France and struck Belgium.

title_en: Iran Says It Reached Agreement with Oman on Hormuz Strait Shipping Roadmap
summary_en: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said on the 15th that despite US obstruction, talks between Iran and Oman made positive progress and the two sides reached an agreement on a shipping roadmap for the Strait of Hormuz, with some issues still under discussion. The segment also reported that Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon killed at least 11 people, drawing condemnation from Lebanese President Joseph Aoun and the Iranian Foreign Ministry.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China Development Bank issued over 10 billion yuan in elderly care industry loans in the first seven months of the year, Guangzhou Baiyun Airport handled over 6.5 million inbound travelers this year, China successfully launched the 24th batch of low-orbit satellite internet satellites via a Long March 12 rocket from Hainan, and 2026 summer box office receipts surpassed 10 billion yuan with total film industry chain output exceeding 400 billion yuan.

title_en: Cultural China Tour: Carving Stones for the Ages — Tuff Cultural Relics Protection Cracks a World Problem
summary_en: The segment reports that China's Academy of Cultural Heritage has since 2011 worked on conserving the tuff stone carvings at the Chengde Mountain Resort and surrounding temples, a UNESCO World Heritage site in Hebei, developing natural calcium-carbonate-based repair materials inspired by Yangshao-era 'liaojiang stone' and a database of some 120 gray tones to guide fine-scale restoration, yielding a full-chain 'Chinese experience' for stone relic protection.

title_en: 【Vital China Research Tour】"Accompaniment" Team Accelerates Innovation
summary_en: The segment reports on Ningbo's Yongjiang Laboratory, a five-year-old new-type research institution in Zhejiang that pairs its 25 scientific research teams with a cross-disciplinary "accompaniment" team to assess market demand and manage the full path from basic research to commercialization; it has so far incubated 35 tech enterprises, and researcher Su Hongjiu's nano-silica polishing abrasive reached thousand-ton mass production and entered mainstream domestic semiconductor firms.

title_en: Grassroots Traditional Chinese Medicine Services Upgraded Further, Bringing Quality Care to Communities
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that localities are implementing the Traditional Chinese Medicine action plan under the health sector's foundation-strengthening project, expanding home visits and bringing specialists down to the grassroots to improve TCM services for rural elderly and disabled patients. By the end of 2025, China had 2,238 county-level TCM hospitals, TCM clinics covered nearly 98% of primary healthcare institutions, and 99% of township health centers and community health service centers could provide TCM services.

title_en: Fishing Season Opens Today in South China Sea and Parts of East China Sea
summary_en: At noon on August 16, the three-and-a-half-month summer fishing moratorium in the South China Sea ended, and fishing opened in China's South China Sea waters and parts of the East China Sea. About 32,000 fishing boats in Guangdong and more than 29,000 in Hainan set out in batches, with law-enforcement vessels escorting them, and the Qiongzhou Strait passenger-roll-on/roll-off service was temporarily suspended from 17:00 today to 5:30 the next day to ensure maritime traffic safety.

title_en: Henan, Jiangsu and Other Regions Intensify Flood Control and Disaster Relief Work
summary_en: Henan and Jiangsu are stepping up flood control and disaster relief amid continuous heavy rainfall, with breaches in dikes along the Qingyi River in Yanling County, Xuchang, and the Jialu River in Chuanhui District, Zhoukou, successfully closed after dozens of hours of emergency work. Water levels in the Taihu Lake basin in Jiangsu remain high, with the Pingwang hydrological station on the Taipu River reaching 4.52 meters, and the Central Meteorological Observatory forecasts increased rainfall in eastern Heilongjiang and eastern Jilin over the next two days, with more rain expected in northern China and southern China after the 17th.

title_en: Source Innovation Drives New Momentum for Industrial Development
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's national key laboratories are targeting key links in industrial chains and achieving breakthroughs in core technologies, including a supercritical CO2 oil recovery and carbon storage technique scaled up at major oilfields such as Daqing, Shengli and Changqing, and hydrogen-safety technologies applied at refueling stations in Qingdao and Shenzhen. More than 500 laboratories have been restructured, basic research funding has grown at an average annual rate of 13.6% over the past five years, and central SOE annual basic research investment has exceeded 100 billion yuan.

title_en: Building a Denser Rural Logistics Network to Unleash New Vitality in the Countryside
summary_en: The segment reports that localities across China have been upgrading rural logistics systems this year, citing Luzhou in Sichuan setting up courier collection points at orchard entrances to shorten lychee cold-chain times, new passenger-freight-postal buses in Pingtang, Guizhou, and dedicated vegetable and fruit bus routes, alongside national policies including the 15th Five-Year Plan for accelerating agricultural and rural modernization. It also cites China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing data showing rural e-commerce logistics volume rose more than 20% year-on-year in July.

title_en: Chongqing Accelerates Deep Integration of Technological and Industrial Innovation
summary_en: Chongqing is building a full-chain ecosystem for industry-academia-research collaboration to match enterprise needs with technological solutions, aiming to speed up construction of a nationally influential science and technology innovation center. The segment reports that the city has introduced 39 high-level new R&D institutions and built 22 national excellence-level smart factories and 10 future factories, with a goal of building 50 national-level science and technology innovation platforms by 2030.

title_en: Comrade Zhu Rongji's Body to Be Cremated on the 18th; Flags to Fly at Half-Mast at Tiananmen and Elsewhere in Mourning
summary_en: The body of Comrade Zhu Rongji, outstanding member of the Communist Party of China, veteran and loyal communist fighter, distinguished proletarian revolutionary and statesman, and former Premier of the State Council, will be cremated in Beijing on the 18th. To mourn him, flags will fly at half-mast on the 18th at Tiananmen, Xinhua Gate, the Great Hall of the People, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the capital, at the seats of Party committees and governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, in the Hong Kong and Macao Special Administrative Regions, at border ports, at international sea and air ports, and at Chinese embassies and consulates abroad.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Airing Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air episodes 11, 'People's Sentiments,' and 12, 'Song of the Great Way,' tonight (August 16) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel.

title_en: Grand gathering commemorating the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth to be held in Beijing on the morning of the 17th; Xi Jinping to attend and deliver an important speech
summary_en: A grand gathering commemorating the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth will be held at 10 a.m. on August 17 at the Great Hall of the People, and Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, will attend and deliver an important speech. CCTV, China National Radio and China Radio International channels will carry the event live, with major central new-media platforms simulcasting.

title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Improving Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Capacity
summary_en: The 16th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on August 16, carries an article by Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, titled "Improving Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Capacity." The article stresses the Party's leadership and a people-first approach in disaster work, calls for shifting disaster governance toward pre-disaster prevention, strengthening response capacity for major catastrophes, and enhancing scientific, technological and legal support and grassroots foundations.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports a magnitude 7.7 earthquake near Indonesia's Flores Island that killed at least 38 people, Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi saying Iran will not extend its ceasefire agreement with the United States, Cuban Foreign Minister Rodríguez condemning U.S. maximum pressure and economic strangulation of Cuba, a sharp drop in U.S. consumer confidence in August, and record-low river levels in Europe amid ongoing drought.

title_en: International figures criticize Japan for distorting history and accelerating 'remilitarization' and other dangerous moves
summary_en: International figures said the Japanese government has not faced history or reflected on its wartime aggression but has instead continued to expand its military and accelerate a 'remilitarization' process, a dangerous trend that threatens regional and world peace and stability. People from multiple countries said Japan should learn from the history of World War II and must not repeat the mistakes of militarism.

title_en: Japanese Citizens Hold Rally Urging Japanese Government to Reflect on Aggression War Crimes
summary_en: On August 15, the 81st anniversary of Japan's announcement of unconditional surrender, Japanese citizens spontaneously held a rally and march in Tokyo urging the Japanese government to face up to its history of aggression and reflect on its war crimes.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's railways carried 2.8 billion passengers in the first seven months of the year, up 4.1% year-on-year, and that trade between the China-CEEC economic cooperation demonstration zone and Central and Eastern European countries exceeded 37.35 billion yuan over the same period. It also covers new guidelines on pricing for laboratory medical services, a consumer green consumption guide, the start of regular seasonal operations on a China-Europe Arctic container route from Ningbo-Zhoushan Port, and the launch of a CMG film culture carnival in Tianjin.

title_en: News Feature: China, I Will Come Again!
summary_en: The segment reports on the growing popularity of "China travel" among foreign tourists this summer, following Portuguese tourist Anna, now on her second trip to China, as she and other visitors experience traditional culture, immersive theater, modern technology, visa-free policies and mobile payments, and describes how first-time visitors are becoming repeat visitors.

title_en: Localities Innovate to Advance Complete Community Development
summary_en: CCTV reports that localities across China are accelerating efforts to fill gaps in community services such as elderly care, childcare, convenience stores, parking and green space, with more than 780 complete-community projects newly started nationwide by the end of June against a target of about 1,000 this year. The Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development said next steps will focus on expanding and upgrading complete-community construction, improving public service facilities and promoting smarter community services.

title_en: Severe Rainstorms Hit Multiple Regions; Flood Control and Disaster Relief Efforts Intensify
summary_en: CCTV reports that heavy rainfall has struck multiple parts of China, with a 117-meter breach in a dike along the Jialu River in Chuanhui District, Zhoukou, Henan, more than 90 meters of which had been sealed by the afternoon of August 15, while central authorities allocated flood-control supplies and 30 million yuan for post-disaster recovery in Henan. Short-term torrential rain also caused widespread flooding in Changxing County, Zhejiang, prompting evacuations, and the national flood control headquarters raised Jiangsu's emergency response from Level IV to Level III and activated a Level IV response for Zhejiang.

title_en: China Takes Multiple Measures to Accelerate Green and Low-Carbon Development
summary_en: The 2026 National Ecology Day main event was held in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia, under the theme "Cultivating the Green Foundation of Chinese-Style Modernization," where the National Development and Reform Commission and other departments reported that since 2012 China has supported average annual economic growth of 6.1% with energy consumption growth of 3.4% per year, making it one of the countries with the fastest declines in energy and carbon intensity. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China will carry out carbon peaking actions, promote integrated conservation of energy, water, grain, land, minerals and materials, and upgrade recycling capacity for key renewable resources, aiming for the resource recycling industry's output value to reach 8 trillion yuan by 2030.

title_en: 81st Anniversary of Japan's Unconditional Surrender: Events Across China Honor History and Martyrs
summary_en: On the 81st anniversary of Japan's announcement of unconditional surrender, commemorative events were held across China at war-related memorial sites, including the Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, the September 18th History Museum in Shenyang, and the Memorial Hall of the Victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression in Zhijiang, Hunan. New historical evidence was also made public, including materials on Japanese chemical warfare and new documents and testimony concerning Unit 731, while military units held activities drawing on wartime history.

title_en: Focusing Efforts, Working Diligently to Achieve a Good Start for the 15th Five-Year Plan: Beijing Builds a Historic and Cultural City, Integrating Preservation with Development
summary_en: The segment reports that Beijing, in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, is pursuing integrated preservation and development of its historic old city, introducing a "menu-style" renovation model for residents' homes and completing planning for 39 historic and cultural conservation areas. It also outlines plans to link cultural resources along the central axis and the Great Wall, Grand Canal, and Western Hills-Yongding River cultural belts into four urban vitality zones during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air episodes nine, 'Jiuzhou Fangyuan,' and ten, 'Wuzhou Jihui,' tonight (August 15) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast on the science and education channel at 10 p.m.

title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: Rule of Law Safeguards Building of a Beautiful China, Laying a Solid Ecological Foundation for the Chinese Nation's Sustainable Development
summary_en: On National Ecology Day (August 15), the PRC Ecological Environment Code took effect, marking a new stage of codified, systematic governance of ecological and environmental protection. The segment reports on Xi Jinping's guidance on ecological civilization, the tenth anniversary of the river chief system with over 1.2 million river and lake chiefs and 1.3 million forest chiefs, central ecological inspection and compensation mechanisms, and expanded public participation in environmental protection.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Yemen's Houthi armed group said it attacked an Aramco refinery in Saudi Arabia's Jizan region with drones; Brazil launched proceedings under its economic reciprocity law to counter new US tariffs on Brazilian products; a new heatwave hit Europe with over 135 million people facing temperatures above 35°C and wildfires forcing evacuations in Britain, France and Croatia; storms in the US Midwest left over 36 million people under flood warnings; and a train derailed near a station in East Sussex, England, injuring 11 people.

title_en: Iran Says It Will Escalate Conflict If Conditions Not Met; U.S. Says It Can Maintain Naval Blockade Indefinitely
summary_en: An advisor to Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said on the 13th that Iran has made a clear strategic decision to escalate the conflict if its conditions—including a permanent halt to military action against Iran and its regional allies, an end to the naval blockade, war reparations, and the lifting of sanctions—are not met. U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseth said the U.S. military can maintain the naval blockade of Iran "indefinitely," while Treasury Secretary Bessent said Washington would take "unprecedented" measures against Iran's economy; U.S. media reported that the U.S. military has lost at least 45 MQ-9 "Reaper" drones in the conflict with Iran, and that the U.S. is preparing to send the USS George Washington to the Middle East to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln.

title_en: World 'Comfort Women' Victims Remembrance Day Marked in South Korea and the Philippines
summary_en: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung issued a written message as the South Korean government held a ceremony in Seoul commemorating the victims, while in the Philippines families of victims and civil society groups protested outside the Japanese embassy calling for justice.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the release of the 15th Five-Year Plan for the safety and emergency equipment industry, a 2.4% year-on-year rise in China's express delivery development index for July, completion of track-laying on the Xiong'an-Xinzhou high-speed railway, the publication of China's first ISO international standard in the nuclear fusion fueling field, and an upcoming High-Level Interview with Fields Medal winner Martin Hairer.

title_en: China Achieves Notable Results in Bird Protection
summary_en: China's National Forestry and Grassland Administration released data showing notable progress in bird protection, with 1,140 important habitats identified along migratory bird flyways and stable or growing populations for 19 nationally protected species including the crested ibis, Saunders's gull, and brown eared pheasant. The segment also reported that synchronized monitoring this winter recorded 1.67 million waterbirds of 167 species, totaling 6.324 million birds, up 158.9 percent from 2.443 million in 2016 and the highest total recorded to date.

title_en: Policy Measures Boost Inbound Consumption as Departure Tax Refunds Grow Significantly in Many Regions
summary_en: One month after the launch of the upgraded "Departure Tax Refund 2.0" policy, departure tax refund applications and refund amounts have risen sharply across China, with Hangzhou airport's application volume and value both more than tripling year-on-year in July, Guangzhou customs verifying over 100 million yuan in refund applications (up about 1.5 times), Sichuan's application volume up 2.4 times, and Beijing's application volume up 516.31% in the first seven months of the year.

title_en: Persistent Rainfall Across Multiple Regions; Flood Control and Disaster Relief Efforts Intensify
summary_en: CCTV reports continued heavy rain across parts of China, including levee breaches on the Jialu River in Zhoukou, Henan, where 455 trapped people were evacuated, and on the Beiru River in Jiaxian, Pingdingshan, where over 2,000 residents were relocated. The Ministry of Water Resources activated a major flood and drought disaster response mechanism, and central authorities allocated 30,000 relief items and 80 million yuan in emergency funds to support Henan, Hubei and Anhui.

title_en: Financial aggregates grow reasonably in first seven months; social financing environment remains accommodative
summary_en: CCTV reports that People's Bank of China data show M2 at 355.51 trillion yuan, up 7.7% year-on-year, and outstanding social financing at 463.27 trillion yuan, up 7.4%, at end-July 2026, with both growth rates above nominal GDP growth. RMB loan balances reached 282.29 trillion yuan, up 5.1%, while weighted average rates on new corporate loans were slightly below 3.0% and on new personal housing loans about 3.1%.

title_en: Central Propaganda Department and Other Departments Jointly Issue Notice Requiring Study and Publicity of the Ecological Environment Code
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The Central Propaganda Department and 18 other departments and units jointly issued a notice deploying study and publicity work for the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China, the country's second law named a "code" after the Civil Code. The notice calls for using the August 15 National Ecology Day and the code's formal entry into force to carry out public publicity and themed activities promoting ecological civilization and the rule of law.

title_en: Jiangsu Accelerates Intelligent Manufacturing by Clearing AI Empowerment Bottlenecks
summary_en: Jiangsu, a major manufacturing province, is helping enterprises overcome obstacles to AI-enabled upgrading, including through Kunshan's coordination group that has reviewed over 170 application scenarios and matched firms with AI partners. The province's June "AI + Manufacturing" plan aims for over 20% AI scenario coverage at about 5,000 advanced-level smart factories by 2027.

title_en: [Establishing and Practicing a Correct View of Political Achievements] Promoting Learning Through Action, Driving Learning and Education Deeper and More Substantial
summary_en: The segment reports on how Xishuangbanna in Yunnan and Heihe in Heilongjiang are combining study, inspection, and rectification under the campaign to establish a correct view of political achievements, with Xishuangbanna organizing officials to visit villages and resolve livelihood problems such as weak logistics and helping farmers sell produce, and Heihe focusing on improving cultural tourism services amid rising cross-border passenger flows.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air episodes seven, 'True Colors in the Storm,' and eight, 'A New Chapter for Elite Troops,' tonight (August 14) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel.

title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: Dividing the 'Cake' to Enrich and Benefit the People — Zhejiang Solidly Advances Construction of Common Prosperity Demonstration Zone
summary_en: The segment reports on Zhejiang's progress in building its common prosperity demonstration zone over the past five-plus years, highlighting mobile medical services, integrated public services, rural infrastructure, elderly care, and childcare reforms aimed at equalizing basic public services between urban and rural areas.

title_en: At Xi Jinping's Invitation, Ecuadorian President to Visit China
summary_en: At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, President Daniel Roy-Gilchrist Noboa Azín of the Republic of Ecuador will pay a state visit to China from August 16 to 23.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Russian President Vladimir Putin visited the disputed South Kuril Islands for the first time, drawing a strong protest from Japan; that U.S. strategic petroleum reserves fell to 298.7 million barrels, a 43-year low; that a U.S. Apache military helicopter crashed near Fort Hood in Texas, killing two; that Italy's Mount Etna continued erupting, disrupting flights at Catania airport; and that all French mainland regions have imposed water restrictions amid drought.

title_en: Colombia: Search and Rescue Continues After Earthquake; Country Enters Economic State of Emergency
summary_en: Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos said the powerful earthquake that struck the country on the 10th had killed 265 people, injured 3,494 and destroyed more than 11,000 homes, with over 50,000 homes damaged to varying degrees; he also declared a state of economic emergency. Search and rescue and damage assessment are continuing, with medical staff and volunteers setting up temporary medical points near the rubble in the hard-hit cities of Cali and Pereira.

title_en: South Korean Civic Groups Hold Commemoration for 'Comfort Women' Victims
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): South Korean civic groups held a protest rally on the 12th in front of the Japanese Embassy in Seoul, calling on the Japanese government to face history squarely, reflect on its war crimes, and formally apologize and pay compensation over the 'comfort women' issue.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that market regulators have handled over 23,000 cases of food additive misuse since April last year, that the first section of the Lianyungang-Yizheng crude oil pipeline began operation, that the Shiziyang Bridge completed its anchorage main structure, that the Three Gorges hub's throughput reached 100 million tons this year, that Suzhou Industrial Park's foreign trade exceeded 1 trillion yuan in the first seven months, and that summer box office takings surpassed 9.1 billion yuan with record admissions and screenings.

title_en: China's Asian elephant population grows against global trend
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that monitoring data from the National Forestry and Grassland Administration show China's wild Asian elephant population has risen to nearly 400, up from about 150 in the 1980s, even as global numbers decline. The segment notes that 11 nature reserves have been established in Yunnan, along with designated habitat and food-source areas, and that the Xishuangbanna rescue and breeding center has taken in over 30 wild elephants, including a young male released back into the wild.

title_en: National Mobile Medical Teams Provide On-Site Assistance, Bringing Quality Care to Central and Western County-Level Areas
summary_en: Under a regular mobile medical program by the National Health Commission and the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, 89 national medical teams have been formed this year to provide on-site assistance at the grassroots level, with teams dispatched during the summer to county-level areas in central and western China, including Yongcheng County in Lijiang, Yunnan, and Yonghe County in Linfen, Shanxi. Over the past 15 years, 342 national mobile medical teams have been sent to train grassroots medical personnel through teaching rounds and lectures, aiming to leave behind a medical team that cannot be taken away.

title_en: Rain Continues Across Central and Eastern China; Regions and Departments Respond with Multiple Measures
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that sustained rainfall has affected parts of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, Henan, Hubei, and Anhui, prompting Henan to activate the Nihewa flood storage and detention area in Wuyang County, Luoyang, where 4,567 people in 10 villages were evacuated in advance, and Anhui to divert Ying River floodwater via the artificial Cihuaixin River. The National Disaster Prevention and Relief Office and Ministry of Emergency Management, together with the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration, allocated 20,000 central relief items including folding beds, blankets, and family emergency kits to Henan and Hebei.

title_en: China Accelerates Construction of Next-Generation Communications Networks
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that China is speeding up next-generation communications infrastructure, including 136 10-gigabit optical network pilot projects launched since 2025, the upgrade of 5G base stations to 5G-A, and a Ministry of Industry and Information Technology pilot program for 6G innovation targeting self-developed 6G technical solutions by 2029.
