It also notes accelerated satellite internet deployment, including the national low-orbit constellation and the Qianfan commercial constellation, and completed testing of direct-to-satellite phone connectivity.

title_en: China's normalized assistance achieves a steady start
summary_en: CCTV reports that this year, the first of China's normalized assistance efforts, a policy system covering monitoring and assistance plus industrial and employment support has been basically established to prevent any large-scale return to poverty; monitoring mechanisms are operating effectively, industrial support is expanding, and the central government has allocated 177 billion yuan in normalized assistance funds, with more than 32 million people lifted out of poverty now employed.

title_en: Financial Services for the Real Economy Continue to Improve in Quality and Efficiency
summary_en: The People's Bank of China's latest report says the moderately loose monetary policy has continued to take effect this year, with relatively accommodative social financing conditions and improving quality and efficiency in financial services for the real economy; by end-June, loans to technology, green, inclusive, elderly care, and digital economy sectors continued to grow faster than total loans, and the weighted average interest rate on new loans to small, medium, and micro private enterprises fell 40 basis points year-on-year, benefiting about 2.5 million market entities. In the next stage, the PBOC will use and adjust monetary policy tools as appropriate to keep liquidity ample and social financing conditions relatively loose, strengthen coordination with fiscal policy, and step up countercyclical adjustment to expand domestic demand and optimize supply.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan: China Advances Comprehensive Beautiful China Initiative
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on August 13, an official from the Ministry of Ecology and Environment briefed on progress in building a Beautiful China, reporting that in the first seven months of the 15th Five-Year Plan's opening year, national average PM2.5 concentration fell 6.2% year-on-year and the share of days with good air quality rose 3.9 percentage points, while surface water at Grade I-III reached 86.5%. The ministry aims by 2030 to bring national PM2.5 below 27 micrograms per cubic meter, raise the share of good-quality water bodies to 85%, complete environmental improvement in 80,000 administrative villages, and support about 200 cities in building "zero-waste cities."

title_en: Tianjin Continues to Strengthen Port Support and Promote Integrated Port-Industry-City Development
summary_en: Tianjin is leveraging its port advantages to develop modern shipping services and integrate port, industry, and city development under the 15th Five-Year Plan, with the city's port container routes reaching 152 and a goal of 600 billion yuan in output value for five major port-related industries in Binhai New Area by 2030.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, episodes five and six of the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air tonight (August 13) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast on the science and education channel at 10 p.m.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Making the 'Cake' Bigger and Narrowing Gaps — Zhejiang Solidly Advances Construction of Common Prosperity Demonstration Zone
summary_en: The segment reports on Zhejiang's progress in building the common prosperity demonstration zone since May 2021, including upgraded mountain-sea cooperation pairing mechanisms, county-level industrial development, and rural revitalization through the 'Ten Thousand Villages' initiative, with the urban-rural income ratio narrowing from 1.96 to 1.81 and rural per capita disposable income reaching 27,555 yuan in the first half of the year.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Houthi claims of missile and drone strikes on Saudi-linked targets in Yemen's Taiz and Marib provinces, including an attack on a vessel in the Bab al-Mandab Strait that Yemeni coast guard described as a commercial ship, with no Saudi response; Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi's visit to Iran and Defense Minister Khawaja Asif's remarks that the US and Iran are close to an agreement; and Congo's Ebola outbreak surpassing 2,000 deaths out of nearly 4,400 confirmed cases.

title_en: Severe Earthquake Disaster in Colombia as Rescue Efforts Intensify
summary_en: CCTV News reports that a magnitude-7.5 earthquake in northwestern Colombia has killed 188 people and injured 1,677, according to statistics released on the 11th by the National Federation of Departments of Colombia, with rescue operations intensifying; UN Secretary-General António Guterres issued a statement through Deputy Spokesperson Farhan Haq saying the UN is in close contact with the Colombian government and supports its relief work, and the World Food Programme has launched assistance at Colombia's request.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China has allocated 3.196 billion yuan in central funds for drainage capacity projects in 13 key regions, that the Yellow River has flowed continuously for 27 years, and that China delivered the world's largest multi-purpose heavy-lift vessel; it also covers the C919's first international commercial route to Ulaanbaatar and the departure of the Navy's 49th escort task force for the Gulf of Aden.

title_en: National Vegetable Supply Situation Generally Stable
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's in-field vegetable acreage has reached 106 million mu, with coordinated scheduling and staggered harvests ensuring ample market supply; highland and northern summer-autumn vegetable areas are now the mainstay of supply as southern open-field vegetables slow due to sustained high temperatures, and major supermarkets and wholesale markets are broadening procurement channels, keeping overall prices stable and controllable.

title_en: Localities and Departments Actively Respond to Severe Rainstorms
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that heavy rainfall from the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin has hit central and eastern China, prompting emergency responses: flash flooding in Yuzhou, Henan, where a villager was rescued after clinging to a tree; train suspensions and speed restrictions in Zhengzhou; the national flood control emergency response for Henan raised from Level IV to Level III; over 14,100 people evacuated in Xiangyang, Hubei; and an orange rainstorm warning in Beijing with drainage crews deployed and 77 elevated roads opened for emergency parking.

title_en: Nuclear Power Construction Steadily Advances, Total Installed Capacity Ranks First in the World
summary_en: CCTV reports that China has stepped up nuclear power project construction this year, with 57 approved units under construction—more than half the global total—and total installed capacity of operating and approved units reaching 135 million kilowatts, the world's largest. In late July, eight more units were approved, the first batch under the 15th Five-Year Plan, as China continues its "active, safe and orderly development" principle and expands the coastal nuclear power belt.

title_en: China's Auto Exports Continue Strong Growth Momentum
summary_en: CCTV News reported on August 12, citing the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, that China's auto exports reached 1.043 million vehicles in July, up 81.3% year-on-year, with new energy vehicle exports at 553,000 units, up 145.5% year-on-year. Monthly exports exceeded one million vehicles for two consecutive months, with new energy vehicles accounting for over 50% of exports for two consecutive months, which the association attributed to China's complete auto supply chain and advances in intelligent features such as smart driving and cabin interaction.

title_en: Obituary of Comrade Zhu Rongji Issued by the CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council and CPPCC National Committee
summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, the NPC Standing Committee, the State Council and the CPPCC National Committee announce the death of Zhu Rongji, former premier and Standing Committee member of the 14th and 15th CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, who died in Beijing on August 12, 2026, at age 98 after illness. The obituary recounts his career, including his tenure as Shanghai party secretary, vice premier and premier, and credits him with leading fiscal, tax, financial and state-owned enterprise reforms, managing the response to the Asian financial crisis, and completing negotiations for China's WTO accession.

title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Continues Airing Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-part documentary 'Jiang Zemin' will air its third episode, 'Taking Command in Crisis,' and fourth episode, 'Major Breakthroughs,' tonight (August 12) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel, with a rebroadcast at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel.

title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey: Comprehensive Multidimensional Transport Network Construction Accelerates Toward Western China's Interior
summary_en: The segment reports that, at the start of the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China is accelerating construction of its comprehensive multidimensional transport network toward western regions, with the Pinglu Canal beginning full-scale live vessel trials on August 12 ahead of its September opening as a key project of the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor. It cites progress in western highway, rail and airport infrastructure, including a rise in rail operating mileage in the west from 59,100 to 67,300 kilometers over five years and expansion of Kunming Changshui Airport.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on the UN Yemen envoy's warning that escalating tensions could plunge Yemen back into full-scale conflict, a surge in Israeli settler violence in the West Bank, a renewed sharp fall in the yen against the dollar, and a joint criticism of FIFA by the UEFA, AFC and CONCACAF over the proposed FIFA Forward company.

title_en: Data shows U.S. average temperature in July reached a new high
summary_en: Citing National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration data released on the 10th, the segment reports that the U.S. average temperature in July reached a record high of about 24.94 degrees Celsius, that July precipitation was the third-lowest on record, and that about half of the United States was in drought as of early August; it also covers drought and wildfires across Europe, including restrictions on water use for about 27 million people in the UK, crisis-level drought in over two-thirds of France's provinces, drought affecting about 95% of Slovakia, and a wildfire in Spain's Huelva province that burned over 200 square kilometers and forced the evacuation of more than 800 residents.

title_en: US Claims Full Control of Strait of Hormuz; Iran Criticizes US Blockade for Hindering Resumption of Shipping
summary_en: US President Trump said the US "100 percent" controls the Strait of Hormuz and that the US military has cleared mines throughout the waterway, while Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said the US naval blockade and military actions against Iran are the main obstacle to fully restoring safe navigation through the strait. Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba signed orders reshuffling senior military personnel, and Iranian President Pezeshkian said Mojtaba is in "good health" after a roughly seven-hour meeting.

title_en: Magnitude 7.5 Earthquake Strikes Colombia, Country Enters "State of National Disaster"
summary_en: A magnitude 7.5 earthquake struck northwestern Colombia with a depth of 80 kilometers, killing 132 people, injuring 570, and severely affecting 32 cities, prompting the country to declare a "state of national disaster." President Juan Manuel Santos said the top priority is rescuing people trapped under the rubble.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's large internet companies posted over 1 trillion yuan in internet business revenue in the first half of 2026, that the 15th Five-Year Plan will establish a national master catalog of immovable cultural relics, that the market regulator approved 338 national standards, and that the first round of a deepened anti-organized-crime campaign led to more than 8,200 arrests; it also covers 29.9% growth in China-Laos Railway import-export value in the first seven months, the hoisting of the world's first 500-megawatt impulse hydropower unit rotor at the Zhala hydropower station in Tibet, and the 38th Hundred Flowers Film Awards in Beijing.

title_en: [Cultural China Tour] Ancient Scripts Project Unveils the Veil of Remote Antiquity
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's major cultural project on ancient scripts and the transmission of Chinese civilization has entered the final stage of its first phase, with an exhibition of more than 270 items at the National Museum of China showcasing oracle bone inscriptions, bronze inscriptions, and bamboo and silk manuscripts, alongside achievements such as a major oracle bone compilation and the training of over 1,300 students.

title_en: Party Flag Flies High at the Grassroots: Warm-hearted Protection in the Storm
summary_en: The segment reports that under the influence of Typhoon Dolphin, parts of Zhejiang experienced sustained heavy rainfall, and Party members and officials worked on the front lines to prevent flooding and eliminate dangers, including a village official who dove into muddy water to clear a blocked drainage outlet in Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, and emergency teams in Xiangshan County, Ningbo, who patrolled aquaculture areas every three hours to protect fish farmers.

title_en: Regions and Departments Actively Respond to Impact of Typhoon Baihaitun
summary_en: Heavy rain from Typhoon Baihaitun caused flooding and water levels above warning thresholds in parts of Jiangsu, Anhui, Hubei and Henan, prompting emergency drainage, evacuations and traffic controls. The National Development and Reform Commission allocated 200 million yuan in central budget investment to support post-disaster recovery in Zhejiang, and the national flood control headquarters launched a Level IV flood response for Beijing and Tianjin.

title_en: China to Accelerate Building of a Modern Coal Industry System
summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration jointly released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development, which calls for optimizing coal development layout, raising access standards for coal resource development, phasing out outdated and ineffective capacity, and promoting clean and efficient coal use. By 2030, the share of capacity from large modern coal mines is to reach 87 percent and smart coal mines 75 percent, with coalbed methane output reaching 26 billion cubic meters as a modern coal industry system is basically completed.

title_en: China's Ecological Quality to Improve Steadily During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment has issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Ecological Protection," which sets targets for 2030 including raising the share of land under protected areas to at least 18%, soil and water conservation reaching over 74%, and forest coverage reaching 25.8%. The plan focuses on consolidating the national ecological security barrier system, building a green barrier in the "Three-North" project region, and strengthening biodiversity and habitat protection.

title_en: Locales Seize Farming Season to Improve Field Management
summary_en: The segment reports that regions across China are seizing the farming season to carry out field management tailored to local conditions, including pest and disease control for rice in the northeast, heat-mitigation measures for rice in Jilin, scientific fertilization and pest control for corn in Hebei and Shaanxi, and mechanized harvesting of rice in Sichuan and Guizhou, all aimed at safeguarding a grain harvest.

title_en: Documentary Film 'Jiang Zemin' Begins Airing Tonight
summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, a 12-part documentary film 'Jiang Zemin,' co-produced by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Institute of Party History and Literature of the CPC Central Committee, the National Radio and Television Administration, and China Media Group, premieres tonight (August 11) at 8 p.m. on CCTV's comprehensive channel and rebroadcasts at 10 p.m. on the science and education channel. The film reviews Jiang Zemin's more than 70-year revolutionary career and highlights his achievements and lofty style; the first episode, 'Weathering Trials,' and the second, 'Daring to Explore,' air today.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Weaving a Denser and Warmer Social Security Safety Net
summary_en: The segment reports on China's efforts to strengthen its social security system, citing Xi Jinping's statements on social security as a basic institutional safeguard for livelihoods and social fairness, and describing reforms including Zhejiang's big-assistance information platform that shifts from "people seeking policies" to "policies seeking people," expanded occupational injury protection for new employment forms, the first specialized social assistance law, and the nationwide rollout of long-term care insurance as a "sixth insurance."

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Message of Condolence to Colombian President over Strong Earthquake in Colombia
summary_en: On August 11, President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Colombian President Iván Duque Márquez over the strong earthquake in Colombia, expressing deep sorrow for the casualties and property losses and extending sincere condolences to the bereaved families and the injured on behalf of the Chinese government and people.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that U.S. media say President Trump favors economic pressure on Iran over new military action, that Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met with Supreme Leader Mojtaba, that Russia and Ukraine exchanged claims of territorial gains and strikes on Odessa and Nizhnekamsk, that Danish protesters held a kayak rally in Copenhagen in support of Greenland, and that wildfires continue in Canada, Albania and Spain.

title_en: Houthi Armed Forces Claim Attacks on Yemeni Government Forces and Saudi Refinery
summary_en: Yemen's Houthi armed forces said they used missiles and drones on August 9 to attack a Yemeni government forces assembly point and weapons depot at Mocha port on the Red Sea coast of Taiz province, an attack Yemeni government forces said on August 10 killed at least 7 people and wounded 30. The Houthis also said they struck a Saudi Aramco refinery with drones in response to recent Saudi drone incursions into Yemeni airspace, while Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry reported a fire at an Aramco refinery facility in Jizan with no casualties but did not state the cause.

title_en: Israeli Prime Minister Says Israel Rejects US-Backed Gaza Peace Plan; US Media Says White House "Does Not Care"
summary_en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on the 9th that Israel rejects the Gaza peace plan proposed by the US-initiated "Board of Peace," insisting that Hamas must genuinely disarm, including heavy and light weapons, or Israeli forces will not withdraw from the Gaza Strip. US media, citing a senior US official, reported that the White House "does not care" about Netanyahu's remarks and views them as a "political need" tied to Israel's election.

title_en: Japanese citizens hold rallies protesting dangerous moves by Takaichi administration to expand military and amend constitution
summary_en: On the 81st anniversary of the Nagasaki atomic bombing, some Japanese citizens held a rally in Nagasaki on the 9th protesting the dangerous moves by the Sanae Takaichi government to expand the military and amend the constitution. In Tokyo, some Japanese citizens also held a protest that day, demanding that the Japanese government face up to its history of aggression and uphold peace.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: CCTV's news roundup reports that China has built about 8 million tons of green fuel production capacity as of end-2025, that cumulative inbound and outbound vehicle crossings at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Zhuhai port have surpassed 25 million, that China's 16th Arctic Ocean expedition is conducting ice station surveys with the Xuelong and Xuelong 2 vessels, and that endangered forest musk deer were filmed in Wuxi County, Chongqing.

title_en: Splendid Land of China
summary_en: The segment presents scenic views of majestic mountains across China, closing the broadcast with a blessing for the motherland's enduring landscape and prosperity.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that U.S.-Iran talks have reached a stalemate, that Iraq's Prime Minister Mohammed Shia al-Sudani announced the end of the U.S.-led international coalition's mission in Iraq, and that a Dubai flight to Tel Aviv diverted and made an emergency landing after a security incident, which Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called a very serious security incident.

title_en: Chinese Embassies and Missions Abroad Hold Events Marking 77th Anniversary of the Founding of New China
summary_en: Chinese embassies and missions abroad, including those in the United States, New York, ASEAN, Hungary, Malaysia, Cambodia, Saudi Arabia, Senegal, Tunisia, Sweden and Poland, held National Day receptions and other events celebrating the 77th anniversary of the founding of New China, with guests praising China's development achievements and expressing hopes for deeper cooperation.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: At the 20th Asian Games, Chinese athletes Wen Zaiding/Liu Tian won gold in the men's 49er sailing final and Zhang Zhicheng won gold in the men's single canoe slalom final, keeping China atop the medal table with 152 golds, 71 silvers and 62 bronzes as of 18:00 Beijing time on October 1; the 2026 China Open tennis tournament opened at the National Tennis Center in Beijing and runs through October 11, and first-day box office for the 2026 National Day holiday film slate exceeded 150 million yuan.

title_en: National Day Holiday: CMG Offers a Rich Array of Programming
summary_en: CCTV's National Day holiday programming includes the 2026 special program "Chinese Dream, Homeland Sentiment," cultural shows such as "China in Classics" and "China in Intangible Cultural Heritage," a drama on the Red Army's Long March, news specials on the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan and the Long March spirit, the second "Silk Road Star" international music competition, and coverage of the 20th Asian Games and the 2026 China Open.

title_en: National Day Holiday Travel Peak: Transport Departments Mobilize Full Support
summary_en: On the first day of the National Day holiday, China's transport authorities reported an estimated 334 million cross-regional passenger trips, with road travel accounting for nearly 90 percent, as toll-free highway access for small passenger cars took effect at midnight. Railways expected 24.8 million passenger trips with 2,324 additional trains, while waterway passenger volume was projected at 1.34 million and civil aviation at 2.51 million passengers across 19,982 flights.

title_en: Shenzhou-23 astronauts send blessings to the motherland from space
summary_en: On the occasion of National Day, the Shenzhou-23 astronaut crew aboard China's space station, about 400 kilometers above Earth, offered a heartfelt message to the motherland.

title_en: Raising the Same Flag, Jointly Wishing the Motherland Well
summary_en: On October 1, National Day, flag-raising ceremonies were held across China, from Fuyuan in Heilongjiang and the islands of Sansha in Hainan to Khunjerab in Xinjiang and Lhasa in Tibet, marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of New China. The segment also reports ceremonies in Hong Kong and Macao, by Chinese peacekeepers in Mali, South Sudan and Lebanon, and by China Coast Guard and militia personnel at sea, including Wang Shihua, the 'Role Model of the Times,' on Kaishan Island.

title_en: Nation Celebrates Together: Grand Flag-Raising Ceremony Held at Tiananmen Square in the Capital
summary_en: On October 1, marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, a grand flag-raising ceremony was held at Tiananmen Square in Beijing, with people from all walks of life in attendance to offer blessings for the nation's prosperity and the people's well-being.

title_en: CCTV Quick Commentary: The Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation Is Unstoppable — Warmly Celebrating the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the program aired a CCTV Quick Commentary titled "The Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation Is Unstoppable — Warmly Celebrating the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China."

title_en: Forging Ahead Toward the Goal of Building a Great Modern Socialist Country in All Respects — Xi Jinping's Important Speech at the Reception Celebrating the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China Draws Enthusiastic Response
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that Xi Jinping's speech at the reception marking the 77th anniversary of the PRC's founding, in which he said success will belong to the Party, the people and the PRC so long as confidence is firm and goals are held fast, drew enthusiastic response from officials, cadres and citizens, who pledged unity and continued effort to turn the blueprint for a strong nation and national rejuvenation into reality. The segment notes that this year marks the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan and that many workers remained on duty during the National Day holiday, including builders at the Three Gorges waterway project in Yichang, Hubei, and a design team testing new bullet-train models in Changchun, Jilin, while Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan figures said they were encouraged by Xi's remarks.

title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Strengthening Inclusive, Basic and Safety-Net Livelihood Construction
summary_en: The 19th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on October 1, carries an article by Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, titled "Strengthening Inclusive, Basic and Safety-Net Livelihood Construction," an excerpt of his important expositions from November 2012 to January 2026. The article stresses that in Chinese modernization the people's livelihood is paramount, and calls for a people-centered approach to improving education, income distribution, employment, social security, medical care and housing, and for special attention to disadvantaged groups.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Iran says it has received a U.S. reply through mediators on conditions for advancing negotiations, that UK Prime Minister Burnham said he will push to improve relations with the EU, and that a U.S. import ban on some Canadian goods including alcohol, dairy and motorcycles took effect.

title_en: Chinese Missions to International Organizations and Embassies in Multiple Countries Hold Events Celebrating the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of New China
summary_en: Chinese embassies and missions to international organizations recently held National Day receptions and other events marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, including a reception by China's Permanent Mission to the UN on the 29th that was attended by senior UN officials and representatives of various countries, as well as events hosted by Chinese missions in Belgium, the EU, Brazil, and Nigeria.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that 254 national standards take effect on October 1, that China and Europe jointly released the first observation images from the "Smile" satellite, that clearance hours for fresh food supplied to Hong Kong via the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge will extend to 24 hours from October 1, 2026, and that the 33rd China TV Golden Eagle Awards were announced in Changsha.

title_en: Celebrating National Day: Festive Atmosphere Strong Across the Country
summary_en: With National Day approaching, cities across China are decorating streets with Chinese flags and flowers and holding festive events, including light shows in Beijing, Shanghai, Qingdao, Meizhou, Taizhou and Jiayuguan, and ethnic dance performances by Tujia people in Laifeng, Hubei.

title_en: September Manufacturing PMI Rebounds, Returning to Expansion Territory
summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics' Service Industry Survey Center and the China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing reported on September 30 that China's manufacturing PMI rose 0.3 percentage points to 50.1% in September, returning to expansion territory, with the new orders index at 50.5%, the new export orders index at 50%, the production index at 51.7%, and the business activity expectations index at 53.8%.

title_en: Getting the 15th Five-Year Plan Off to a Good Start: China Accelerates Construction of a Modern Water Network
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 30, a Ministry of Water Resources official briefed on accelerating the building of a modern water network, reporting that 41,400 water projects were implemented and 795 billion yuan invested in water conservancy construction from January to September, absorbing 2.01 million workers. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China will speed up development of basin flood control and disaster reduction systems, water resource allocation and supply guarantee systems, water ecosystem protection and governance systems, and digital twin water networks.

title_en: Xi Jinping and Brunei's Sultan Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 35th Anniversary of China-Brunei Diplomatic Relations
summary_en: President Xi Jinping and Brunei's Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah exchanged congratulatory messages marking 35 years of diplomatic ties, with Xi praising the two countries' model of mutual respect and common development and calling for deeper strategic alignment and cooperation. Sultan Hassanal cited the 2025 consensus on building a shared future and called for closer ties in trade, investment, defense and cultural exchanges.

title_en: People's Daily Editorial: Continue Striving and Create New Glory on the New Great Journey — Warmly Celebrate the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the People's Daily will publish an editorial in its October 1 edition titled "Continue Striving and Create New Glory on the New Great Journey — Warmly Celebrate the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China."

title_en: Reception Celebrating the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China Held in Beijing; Xi Jinping Delivers Important Speech
summary_en: A reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on the evening of the 30th, at which Xi Jinping delivered an important speech; Li Qiang presided, and Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi and Han Zheng attended, with about 800 Chinese and foreign guests present.

title_en: Martyrs' Day flower basket ceremony to the People's Heroes held grandly in Beijing
summary_en: On the morning of the 30th, a ceremony to lay flower baskets before the Monument to the People's Heroes was held in Tiananmen Square, attended by Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi, Han Zheng and other Party and state leaders along with representatives from all sectors. Xi Jinping adjusted the ribbons on the flower baskets and, together with other leaders, viewed the monument; the ceremony was presided over by Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: A UN Food and Agriculture Organization report credits China with leading global forest restoration commitments and notes its desertification-control techniques are used in over 40 countries; US President Trump says Washington and Tehran have exchanged messages through mediators, while Iran's foreign minister discusses conditions with Qatar; EU ministers fail to agree on transferring Patriot missiles to Ukraine; and the DRC reports over 8,000 confirmed Ebola cases.

title_en: Chinese Embassies and Missions Abroad Hold Events Celebrating the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China
summary_en: Chinese embassies and missions abroad held National Day receptions with international friends to mark the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. The Chinese Embassy in Ethiopia and the Mission to the African Union co-hosted a reception where guests praised President Xi Jinping's four global initiatives, while receptions in Thailand and the United Kingdom highlighted prospects for deeper bilateral exchanges and cooperation.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: CCTV's news roundup covers eight ministries issuing 19 financial measures to support the service sector, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank's plan to double annual financing to about $20 billion by 2030, the 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit scheduled for November 2-5, China's push to train outstanding engineers with nearly 36,000 engineering master's and doctoral students jointly trained by universities and enterprises, the launch of Zhejiang Province's carbon account management service platform, a joint Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao water enforcement drill, and the launch of the northern main venue of the China Rural Tourism Conference in Handan, Hebei.

title_en: 20th Asian Games: Multiple Events Conclude, China Continues to Lead Medal Table
summary_en: China continued to lead the gold medal standings at the 20th Asian Games as weightlifting concluded, with Wu Yan and Li Wenwen winning gold, and Chinese athletes also took golds in badminton mixed doubles, women's trap team, diving, track cycling team sprint, athletics relays and long jump, and table tennis women's doubles.

title_en: Transport Departments Take Multiple Measures to Serve National Day Holiday Travel
summary_en: CCTV reports that transport authorities expect 340 million passenger trips on October 1, nearly double the daily average, with rental car travel up over 20%; the Ministry of Transport will activate an intelligent forecasting system and coordinate with police to preposition resources at congestion-prone sections. Railway authorities launched a 16-day Mid-Autumn and National Day joint transport plan with extra trains on popular routes and new high-speed lines, while international flight bookings rose 22.5% year-on-year and civil aviation passenger volume is expected to hit a new high for the period.

title_en: Cities Across China Decked Out to Welcome National Day
summary_en: With National Day approaching, cities across China are decorated with five-star red flags, flower displays, and festive banners, and holiday markets are bustling with shoppers; Hong Kong and Macao are also adorned with flags and celebration slogans marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China.

title_en: Autumn Grain Harvest Gets Underway, Localities Seize the Moment to Ensure a Bumper Crop
summary_en: The segment reports that China's autumn grain harvest is entering its harvest period, with localities seizing the moment and taking multiple measures to ensure a bumper autumn harvest. It details mechanized rice harvesting in Jilin and Fujian, corn harvesting in Shandong and Anhui supported by an agricultural machinery app and BeiDou navigation, and soybean harvesting in Heilongjiang.

title_en: Exhibition Marking 90th Anniversary of Long March Victory Opens at Museum of the Communist Party of China
summary_en: Two Long March-themed exhibitions opened on September 29 at the Museum of the Communist Party of China to mark the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, including an archive exhibition of over 230 rare documents, many shown publicly for the first time, and a relics exhibition of more than 270 items and sets such as the "nail shoes" worn crossing the snow mountains and the "half belt" left from crossing the grasslands.

title_en: China to Implement Loan Interest Subsidies for Residents Purchasing Homes
summary_en: Starting October 1, China will provide interest subsidies on newly issued commercial personal housing loans for residents, aimed at lowering home-buying costs and supporting rigid housing demand. The policy targets first homes of ordinary families with floor area up to 120 square meters and purchase price up to 1.5 million yuan, offering a 1-percentage-point annual subsidy on loans up to 1 million yuan for up to five years, with the policy initially set to run for one year.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan: Advancing the Building of a Strong Science and Technology Nation to New Heights
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 29, a Ministry of Science and Technology official outlined the ministry's plans for advancing China's science and technology strength during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, which the plan's outline identifies as a key period for building a strong science and technology nation. The ministry said it will focus on six areas: strengthening basic research, tackling key core technologies, integrating technological and industrial innovation, improving livelihoods through science and technology, enhancing the national innovation system, and promoting high-level openness in science and technology.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: China Accelerates Agricultural and Rural Modernization
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 29, an official from the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs briefed on efforts during the 15th Five-Year Plan period to accelerate agricultural and rural modernization and advance comprehensive rural revitalization, noting that this year, the plan's opening year, grain output is on track for a bumper harvest and rural development has maintained steady progress.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends and Addresses the 2026 Annual Meeting of the China Council for International Cooperation on Environment and Development
summary_en: Ding Xuexiang, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Chairman of the China Council for International Cooperation on Environment and Development (CCICED), attended the CCICED 2026 annual meeting in Beijing on the afternoon of the 29th and delivered a speech, in which he outlined three proposals on green and low-carbon development, green technological innovation, and open cooperation on global environmental and climate governance, and said the Chinese government has formally approved the establishment of the eighth CCICED.

title_en: Symposium Commemorating the 100th Anniversary of Comrade Zou Jiahua's Birth Held in Beijing; Zhao Leji Attends
summary_en: A symposium marking the 100th anniversary of the birth of Zou Jiahua, a former Politburo member and vice premier, was held in Beijing on the 29th, attended by Politburo Standing Committee member and NPC Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji. Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing delivered remarks honoring Zou's life and calling for study of his qualities, and Zhao Leji met with Zou's relatives before the event.

title_en: Xi Jinping's Important Instructions on Building a Peaceful China Draw Warm Response
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that Xi Jinping's important instructions on building a higher-level Peaceful China, which explain the significance and practical path of the initiative, drew a warm response among meeting delegates, the national political and legal front, and Party members and cadres. Attendees said they will firmly implement the overall national security concept, anchor the "four more" goals, and continue to open new prospects for building a Peaceful China.

title_en: Ceremony to Lay Wreaths for People's Heroes Held on Martyrs' Day on the Morning of September 30; Xi Jinping and Other Party and State Leaders to Attend
summary_en: The segment reports that this year marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China and the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Red Army's Long March, and that on the morning of September 30, Martyrs' Day, Xi Jinping and other Party and state leaders will join representatives from all sectors at Tiananmen Square to lay wreaths for the People's Heroes. It notes that CCTV and other central media outlets will carry the event live.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Strive to Be Pioneers and Role Models in Serving the National Strategy of the New Era
summary_en: CCTV aired a Quick Comment on September 29 titled "Strive to Be Pioneers and Role Models in Serving the National Strategy of the New Era," as reported in the Xinwen Lianbo broadcast.

title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from All Faculty and Students of Sichuan University, Stressing the Need to Leverage the Advantages of Integrating Liberal Arts, Science, Engineering and Medicine and Strive to Be Pioneers and Exemplars in Serving the National Strategy of the New Era
summary_en: Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the People's Republic of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, replied to a letter from all faculty and students of Sichuan University on the occasion of its 130th anniversary, congratulating them and urging the university to carry forward its red heritage, leverage its strengths in integrating liberal arts, science, engineering and medicine, and serve the national strategy of the new era. Sichuan University, which traces its origins to the Sichuan Chinese and Western School founded in 1896, is the earliest institution of higher education established in southwest China.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that US President Trump said he expects more talks with Iran this week while considering resuming military strikes, Iran's foreign minister said Tehran is prepared for renewed conflict but has not abandoned diplomacy, Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem vowed not to surrender to Israel, UK police evacuated residents near the US-used RAF Fairford base and arrested five men, and storms across the northeastern US caused widespread power outages.

title_en: Giant Pandas 'Ping Ping' and 'Fu Shuang' Arrive at Atlanta Zoo in the United States
summary_en: On the 27th, Chinese giant pandas 'Ping Ping' and 'Fu Shuang' arrived by charter flight at Atlanta International Airport and were transferred to the Atlanta Zoo for about a month of routine quarantine. Chinese veterinarians and keepers will stay at the zoo for three months to care for the two pandas through the quarantine period and help them adapt to their new environment; both pandas were born in 2020, with Ping Ping male and Fu Shuang female.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the release of the 2025 China Fisheries Ecological Environment Bulletin, the conclusion of the 2026 joint sediment-flushing operation at key reservoirs on the upper and middle Yellow River, the announcement of 10 national rural craftspeople for 2026, and record-high import-export value of 788.9 billion yuan for the Shenzhen Qianhai Cooperation Zone in the first eight months of the year, along with a youth reading campaign, the opening of the 2026 China International Confucius Cultural Festival and Nishan Forum on World Civilizations, the handover of Yuan-dynasty artifacts from the Shengbeiyu shipwreck in Zhangzhou, Fujian, and the broadcast of a TV drama on CCTV.

title_en: Qiantang River Tide Enters Best Viewing Period
summary_en: On the 18th day of the eighth lunar month, the Qiantang River tide entered its annual best viewing period, with the bore surging past Tashan Dam, forming a crossing tide near Liangjiadun, reaching the Yanguan tide-watching park in Haining at 12:52, and producing spectacular return and skyward tides at Laoyancang, where three newly built spur dikes have made the surge more majestic; about 122,000 tourists viewed the tide along the Haining section.

title_en: 20th Asian Games: China Extends Multi-Event Gold Medal Streak
summary_en: At the 20th Asian Games, Chinese athletes won gold in diving, shooting, artistic swimming, athletics, and table tennis, including Yan Ziyi's Asian Games record in the women's javelin and China's sixth consecutive Asian Games title in artistic swimming team competition.

title_en: News Feature: Competing in Skills on the Field, Cultivating Talent with Craftsmanship
summary_en: The 48th WorldSkills Competition closed in Shanghai on the evening of September 27, with China's 71 competitors taking part in all 64 events and winning 41 gold, 11 silver and 4 bronze medals, its best result ever at the competition. The segment highlights 21-year-old Zeng Chen, who won gold in the new drone systems event, and Li Zhuoping, who won the CNC milling event as China extended its streak to six consecutive titles, noting China has now won 134 gold medals in total and ranked first in gold medals and team points for five straight competitions.

title_en: Report Meeting on the Advanced Deeds of "Role Model of the Times" Comrade Wang Ji Held in Beijing Today
summary_en: The Central Propaganda Department, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Science and Technology, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense, Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission, and the Hunan Provincial Party Committee jointly held a report meeting at the Great Hall of the People on the advanced deeds of Comrade Wang Ji, a researcher and doctoral supervisor at the College of Computer Science at National University of Defense Technology and a leading pioneer in China's high-trust software technology field, who continued his research despite serious illness and high-level amputation.

title_en: Mengxiang (Dream) ocean drilling vessel completes trial drilling mission
summary_en: China's Mengxiang (Dream) ocean drilling vessel recently completed a trial deep-sea drilling mission in the South China Sea, recovering basalt core samples from the seafloor, according to the China Geological Survey under the Ministry of Natural Resources. The vessel, the world's only drillship capable of drilling to 11,000 meters, reached a maximum drilling depth of 4,929.17 meters during the 30-day voyage, setting a new record for the deepest drilling conducted independently by China.

title_en: Four High-Speed Rail Lines Open on Same Day, Adding Momentum to the 'Eight Vertical and Eight Horizontal' Network
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reported that on September 28 four high-speed rail lines opened to traffic—the Xiong'an-Shangqiu section of the Beijing-Hong Kong High-Speed Railway, the Harbin-Yichun line (China's northernmost high-speed rail), the Xi'an-Ankang section of the Xi'an-Chongqing High-Speed Railway, and the Yichang-Xingshan line in Hubei—adding over 1,100 kilometers of new high-speed rail mileage. The report said fixed-asset investment in railways has grown steadily this year at an average of 64 billion yuan per month, and that the 'Eight Vertical and Eight Horizontal' high-speed rail network is now 86 percent complete.

title_en: Profits of industrial enterprises above designated size nationwide grew 15.7% year-on-year from January to August
summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics reported on September 28 that industrial enterprises above designated size nationwide posted total profits of 5.27198 trillion yuan in January–August, up 15.7% year-on-year and continuing double-digit growth. Driven by expanded applications of new technologies such as artificial intelligence, electronics industry profits rose 1.1-fold year-on-year, while profits in optical fiber and optical cable manufacturing grew 5.3-fold and 1.0-fold respectively amid accelerated construction of computing infrastructure.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: Promoting New Development of State-Owned Capital and Central Enterprises
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 28, a State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC) official outlined implementation of the 15th Five-Year Plan to advance high-quality development of central enterprises, noting that central enterprise assets reached 99.3 trillion yuan at end-August, up 4.2% year on year, and that R&D spending rose 2.7% year on year in January-August and is expected to exceed 1 trillion yuan for the full year, the fifth consecutive year above that level.

title_en: Wang Huning Meets National Ethnic Minority Delegation
summary_en: Wang Huning, Standing Committee member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC, met in Beijing on the 28th with the national ethnic minority delegation, calling for efforts to study and implement Xi Jinping's speeches and thought on ethnic work, uphold the correct path of resolving ethnic issues with Chinese characteristics, and advance ethnic unity and common prosperity. The 150-member delegation consists of individuals and collective representatives honored at the provincial level or above for ethnic unity and progress since 2024; Li Ganjie and Shen Yiqin also attended.

title_en: General Office of the CPPCC National Committee, United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee, Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council, Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council, and All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese Jointly Hold National Day Reception
summary_en: Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, attended and delivered remarks at a joint National Day reception in Beijing marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, where he called for consolidating the broadest patriotic united front, upholding the "one country, two systems" principle and the one-China principle and the 1992 Consensus, and advancing national reunification. Foreign Minister Wang Yi presided over the reception, which was attended by some 750 representatives from Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and overseas Chinese communities.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on September 28 that studied ways to strengthen and improve the effectiveness of macro policy and boost effective investment, heard a report on progress in tackling new pollutants, and reviewed and approved the draft Regulations on the Registration and Administration of Public Institutions.

title_en: Li Qiang stresses solid implementation of workplace safety measures at national video conference on production safety, vowing to resolutely prevent and curb major and especially serious accidents
summary_en: At a State Council national video conference on production safety on September 28, Premier Li Qiang called for thorough implementation of Xi Jinping's instructions on workplace safety, prioritizing people and life, tightening responsibilities, and resolutely preventing major and especially serious accidents to protect lives, property and social stability. He urged focused action on major-risk scenarios such as fire prevention and mixed-use production sites, key sectors including mining, fireworks, shipbuilding, tourism and transport, and hazardous chemicals, and said central and state-owned enterprises should lead by example; Zhang Guoqing chaired the meeting, with Wang Xiaohong and Wu Zhenglong attending.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Building a Higher-Level Peaceful China to Safeguard the Steady and Far-Reaching Advance of Chinese-Style Modernization
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the program aired a CCTV Quick Comment titled "Building a Higher-Level Peaceful China to Safeguard the Steady and Far-Reaching Advance of Chinese-Style Modernization."

title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Building a Higher-Level Peaceful China, Stressing Unswerving Implementation of the Overall National Security Concept and Ensuring Steady Progress of Chinese-Style Modernization Through Higher-Level Peaceful China Construction
summary_en: Xi Jinping issued instructions stating that Peaceful China construction has achieved notable results since the 18th Party Congress and that China has become one of the safest countries in the world, calling for continued efforts under the overall national security concept to safeguard Chinese-style modernization. A national conference on Peaceful China construction was held in Beijing on the 28th, where Chen Wenqing conveyed Xi's instructions and delivered a speech, Wang Xiaohong gave closing remarks, and 60 demonstration cities and 160 demonstration counties were named.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Oman's Foreign Minister Badr al-Busaidi told the UN General Assembly that Oman remains committed to ensuring safe navigation through the Strait of Hormuz; Yemen's government forces reported repelling Houthi attacks near a key road in Taiz, while the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted missiles and drones; and heavy rain caused widespread flooding in Bangkok, which its mayor Chadchart Sittipunt declared a flood disaster area.

title_en: Advancing International Development Cooperation and Revitalizing the Global Development Cause: International Figures Highly Praise President Xi Jinping's Congratulatory Letter to the High-Level Dialogue on the 5th Anniversary of the Global Development Initiative
summary_en: International figures said President Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter to the High-Level Dialogue on the 5th Anniversary of the Global Development Initiative was encouraging and helped build consensus and confidence for advancing international development cooperation and revitalizing the global development cause. Participants from multiple countries said the Global Development Initiative emphasizes the importance of development issues, responds to the most urgent and fundamental demands of developing countries, and has achieved results and won broad support, with cooperation projects under the initiative taking root and bearing fruit in more than 120 countries over the past five years.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the closing of the fifth Global Digital Trade Expo in Hangzhou, the arrival of the first inbound exhibits for the 140th Canton Fair in Guangzhou, the launch of a Nanchang–Bishkek Central Asia freight train, and the confirmation of a deep coalbed methane field exceeding 100 billion cubic meters in the Ordos Basin.

title_en: PLA Southern Theater Command Conducts Joint Sea-Air Exercise Around Huangyan Dao; China Coast Guard Conducts Rights-Protection Law-Enforcement Drill Near Huangyan Dao
summary_en: The PLA Southern Theater Command organized a joint sea-air exercise in the waters and airspace around Huangyan Dao on September 27, practicing reconnaissance and early warning, rapid maneuver, and joint search and rescue, while the China Coast Guard conducted a rights-protection and law-enforcement control drill nearby involving boarding inspections, interception, and forced towing, and said it would step up such enforcement to counter infringements and safeguard national territorial sovereignty and maritime rights.

title_en: [20th Asian Games] Halfway Through the Schedule, China Leads the Gold and Medal Tables
summary_en: At the 20th Asian Games, Chinese athletes won golds in women's BMX freestyle park (Sun Sibei), women's street skateboarding (Zhu Yuanling), men's trampoline (Yan Langyu and Wang Zisai taking gold and silver), women's synchronized 3m springboard (Chen Yiwen/Chen Jia), men's synchronized 10m platform (Yang Hao/Lian Junjie), artistic swimming duet (Lin Yanjun/Xu Huiyan), women's 77kg weightlifting (He Renxiu), and men's triple jump, where Su Wen set a 36-year-old Asian Games record with 17.42 meters; in table tennis mixed doubles, the pairs Lin Shidong/Kuai Man and Wang Chuqin/Sun Yingsha took gold and silver.

title_en: Giant pandas "Pingping" and "Fushuang" depart for the United States
summary_en: CCTV News reports that on September 27, giant pandas "Pingping" and "Fushuang" flew from Chengdu Shuangliu Airport to Zoo Atlanta in the United States to begin a ten-year stay, with a senior American veterinarian and keeper accompanying them on the flight. China and Zoo Atlanta have conducted cooperative giant panda conservation research for more than twenty years, producing five litters and seven surviving cubs, the best record of China's international giant panda breeding cooperation with Europe and the Americas.

title_en: Cultural China Tour: Bright Moon Illuminates Past and Present — Astronomical Wisdom in Chinese Civilization
summary_en: The segment marks the seventeenth day of the eighth lunar month, when this year's fullest Mid-Autumn moon appears, and explores ancient Chinese astronomical knowledge, including the Taosi observatory site in Xiangfen, Shanxi, where sunrise through an observation slit was used to determine the spring and autumn equinoxes, an early source of the 24 solar terms. It also notes other archaeological traces of astronomical observation, such as Shang-dynasty oracle bone inscriptions from Yinxu recording lunar eclipses and the Chu silk manuscript from Zidanku in Changsha.

title_en: Transport demand remains high during Mid-Autumn holiday, with active short-distance travel
summary_en: The three-day Mid-Autumn holiday ended on September 27, with transport demand remaining high and short-distance travel active; China Railway expected 16.86 million passenger trips on the return peak day and planned 1,398 extra trains, while the Ministry of Transport estimated over 650 million cross-regional person-trips during the holiday, averaging about 220 million per day.

title_en: Enjoying a Colorful Holiday, Sharing Happy Times
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports on Mid-Autumn Festival holiday activities across China, including ancient-architecture tours at the Jinci Museum in Taiyuan, Shanxi; temple fairs and intangible cultural heritage performances in Suzhou, Jiangsu; sunset viewing and music events at Lanshan Park in Yinchuan, Ningxia; and lantern, mooncake, dragon-dance, and fireworks celebrations in Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Hebei, Henan, Guangdong, and Inner Mongolia.

title_en: Consolidating the Cornerstone of National Security, Safeguarding the Peace of Every Household
summary_en: The segment reports on achievements in building a higher-level "Safe China," citing official figures including over 98% public satisfaction with safety for six consecutive years, 258,000 telecom fraud cases solved in 2025 with case registrations down 15.6% year-on-year in the first half of 2026, and a new round of anti-organized-crime work launched in July that dismantled 1,052 gangs in its first phase, alongside 2,849 county-level and 38,500 township-level comprehensive governance centers and 697,000 people's mediation committees nationwide.

title_en: Han Zheng Attends and Addresses General Debate of the 81st UN General Assembly
summary_en: Vice President Han Zheng addressed the general debate of the 81st UN General Assembly at UN headquarters in New York, presenting four proposals on safeguarding the post-war international order, promoting open cooperation for shared development, advancing inter-civilization exchanges, and upholding multilateralism. On the sidelines, Han Zheng met separately with Bulgarian President Iliana Yotova, Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić, Cypriot President Nikos Christodoulides, Ghanaian President John Mahama, and Kiribati President Taneti Maamau.

title_en: Documentary 'Opening the Right Path for Major-Country Relations, Writing a New Chapter in China-US Relations — A Record of President Xi Jinping's State Visit to the United States' Airs Tonight
summary_en: China Media Group's documentary on President Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States airs tonight (September 27) in prime time on CCTV's comprehensive and news channels. The visit, Xi's first state visit to the US in 11 years and part of an exchange of visits by the two heads of state within six months, is described as a milestone in which the leaders held candid, in-depth exchanges on strategic issues concerning bilateral relations and the global situation.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Safeguarding Cultural Heritage to Enrich Contemporary Life
summary_en: The segment reports on China's cultural heritage protection efforts under Xi Jinping's cultural thought, citing his 2002 remarks as Zhejiang party secretary on the West Lake comprehensive protection project and his attention to Jingdezhen ceramics heritage, and noting that with the addition of Jingdezhen's manual porcelain heritage sites China now has 61 World Heritage sites, tied with Italy for the most globally.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Russia's ruling United Russia party won 349 seats in the State Duma, giving it a "constitutional majority"; that EU Energy Commissioner Dan Jørgensen warned EU energy ministers of an energy price crisis linked to the Iran conflict and urged measures to cut gas and electricity demand; and that water levels on Germany's Rhine at Kaub fell to a record-low 2 centimeters, straining shipping.

title_en: Multiple Countries Hold Colorful Events to Celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival
summary_en: CCTV reports that Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations were held in several countries, including a Moscow event co-organized by the China Cultural Center in Moscow, a "Sentiments of Mid-Autumn" event in Budapest, activities at the China Cultural Center in Bangkok, a reception at the Chinese Embassy in Jakarta themed "Tea for Harmony, Blooming Flowers and Full Moon," and celebrations in multiple Canadian cities.

title_en: Pakistani Prime Minister: Four Major Global Initiatives Provide Solid Pillars for Building a Community with a Shared Future for Mankind
summary_en: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, in his speech at the general debate of the 81st UN General Assembly on the 25th, spoke highly of the four major global initiatives proposed by President Xi Jinping.

title_en: Enriching the Connotation of China-U.S. Relations, Promoting Human Development and Progress — International Figures Highly Praise President Xi Jinping's State Visit to the United States
summary_en: International figures said President Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States was of great significance, noting that the two heads of state agreed to further enrich the connotation of China-U.S. relations and jointly build a "constructive strategic and stable relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity," an important step toward the right way for the two countries to get along that injects certainty into the world. They added that China and the United States working toward each other and actively exploring the right way for two major countries to get along will promote the development and progress of all humanity.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's compulsory motor vehicle traffic accident liability insurance paid out 252.4 billion yuan in 2025, that August cultural service consumption sales revenue rose 5.3% year on year, and that China issued its first batch of data property rights registration certificates to 56 enterprises and institutions; it also covers expanded cross-Strait "mini three links" flights for the Mid-Autumn holiday, the first public flight of the self-developed AR-E800 drone, tunnel completion on the Ruijin–Meizhou railway, the closure of the Shituo Yangtze River Bridge highway span on the Chongqing–Wanzhou high-speed rail line, Mid-Autumn box office surpassing 100 million yuan on its first day, the fifth Chinese-language documentary film conference's Golden Seagull awards in Guangzhou, and autumn livestock migration in Xinjiang's Ili Valley.

title_en: 20th Asian Games: China's Gold Medal Count Surpasses 100
summary_en: China's delegation at the 20th Asian Games passed 100 gold medals after winning the women's 50m rifle three positions team event, with additional golds in diving, canoeing and athletics, while the men's football team reached the semifinals for the first time in 28 years.

title_en: "Two Major" Construction Helps Expand Supply of Quality Higher Education Resources
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that the "Two Major" construction initiative is supporting universities in improving basic teaching conditions and expanding quality higher education, including the opening of Hunan University's Science and Innovation Port campus, a 24,000-student increase in undergraduate enrollment at "Double First-Class" universities, and new campuses in central, western, and northeastern regions that account for nearly 50% of such projects.

title_en: Autumn Grain Harvest Across China Advances in an Orderly Manner [On the Fields of Hope]
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that the national autumn grain harvest is nearly 20 percent complete, with over half harvested in the southwest and over 30 percent in the middle and lower Yangtze region, as major producing areas deploy measures such as wide-tracked harvesters in Hubei, centralized grain drying in Henan, and large combine harvesters in Heilongjiang to speed up collection amid rain. The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs will promote late-stage field management by region and category and coordinate machinery supply and demand to seize favorable weather for the harvest.

title_en: Cross-regional passenger flows expected to exceed 210 million today
summary_en: On the second day of the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday, China's transport authorities projected more than 210 million cross-regional passenger trips, with railways expected to carry 13 million passengers and civil aviation 1.91 million, while highway travel was dominated by short-distance self-driving trips.

title_en: People Across China Enjoy the Mid-Autumn Festival Holiday
summary_en: CCTV reports that people throughout China celebrated the Mid-Autumn Festival with festive activities, including a giant flower basket display at Tiananmen Square in Beijing, themed flower beds along Chang'an Avenue, and more than 140 park events in the capital. The segment also covers intangible cultural heritage performances in Guizhou, Shaanxi, Xinjiang, Henan, Zhejiang, Hubei, Anhui, Jiangsu and Shandong, communal banquets in Fujian and Hainan, lantern displays and the Tai Hang fire dragon dance in Hong Kong, a Mid-Autumn concert in Macao, and celebrations at military barracks across the country.

title_en: Han Zheng Meets UN Secretary-General Guterres, Attends High-Level Dialogue on Fifth Anniversary of Global Development Initiative, Reads Xi Jinping's Congratulatory Letter and Delivers Remarks
summary_en: On the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York on September 25, Vice President Han Zheng met UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres, attended a China-hosted high-level dialogue marking the fifth anniversary of the Global Development Initiative, where he read a congratulatory letter from Xi Jinping and delivered remarks, and also met Abdulla Shahid, President of the 81st UN General Assembly session.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to High-Level Dialogue on Fifth Anniversary of Global Development Initiative
summary_en: On September 25, a high-level dialogue marking the fifth anniversary of the Global Development Initiative was held at UN Headquarters in New York, and President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the meeting. In the letter, Xi said the initiative he proposed at the UN General Assembly five years ago aims to advance international development cooperation and accelerate implementation of the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, noting that cooperation projects have taken root in more than 120 countries, and he pledged that China, as the largest developing country and a member of the Global South, will work with all parties to deepen the initiative.

title_en: Xi Jinping returns to Beijing after concluding state visit to the United States
summary_en: On the afternoon of September 26, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after successfully concluding a state visit to the United States. Accompanying him on the same flight were his wife Peng Liyuan, Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, and He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council.

title_en: Xi Jinping Successfully Concludes State Visit to the United States
summary_en: President Xi Jinping concluded his state visit to the United States and returned to Beijing on the afternoon of September 25 local time. Senior U.S. government officials saw him off at the airport, where a 21-gun salute was fired, and overseas Chinese and Chinese students waved the flags of both countries along the route to the airport to celebrate the success of the visit.

title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Hold Tea with US President Trump and Wife
summary_en: On the morning of September 25 local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan held tea with US President Donald Trump and his wife Melania at the White House, where the two heads of state agreed to build a "constructive strategic relationship of stability based on respect, fairness and reciprocity." The segment also reports that Xi and Peng, accompanied by Trump and Melania, visited the US National Archives.

title_en: Traditional Chinese Festival: Mid-Autumn Festival
summary_en: The segment explores the cultural significance of the Mid-Autumn Festival, one of China's four major traditional holidays, tracing its origins to ancient celestial worship and describing customs such as celebrating the harvest, dragon dances, lanterns, and family moon-viewing with mooncakes.

title_en: Sharing the Same Moon: Multiple Countries Hold Mid-Autumn Festival Celebrations
summary_en: CCTV reports that several countries have held Mid-Autumn Festival events, including a celebration at the Yu Garden in Hamburg, Germany; a garden party in Manchester, UK, featuring Qin opera, Kunqu and Sichuan opera face-changing; ongoing Mid-Autumn cultural activities in Foz do Iguaçu, Brazil, with dragon and lion dances, Chinese dance and martial arts; and a joint Mid-Autumn gathering held by the Chinese Embassy in Togo and the local Chinese community, with artists from China and Togo performing together.

title_en: International figures say China-US presidential meeting is significant, contributes positively to addressing global challenges
summary_en: International figures said Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States was of great significance, with the two leaders exchanging views on major issues concerning China-US relations and world peace and development. Xi noted at the White House state dinner the history of the two peoples fighting Japanese militarist aggression over 80 years ago and the experience of American friend Saikos in China's desert control efforts, while international figures said stronger China-US communication and peaceful coexistence contribute to addressing global challenges and offer a useful example for other countries' cooperation.

title_en: [20th Asian Games] China Wins Multiple More Gold Medals
summary_en: At the 20th Asian Games, Chinese athletes won gold medals in canoeing, swimming, shooting, mountain biking, equestrian dressage, weightlifting, and gymnastics, and swept the top two places in the men's discus throw. In the women's table tennis team final, China beat Japan 3-0 to win its sixth consecutive Asian Games team title, while the women's water polo team beat Japan 19-18 to secure a fifth straight Asian Games title in that event.

title_en: Mid-Autumn Festival in Tiangong: Shenzhou-23 Crew Sends Greetings from Orbit
summary_en: The Shenzhou-23 crew, four months into their mission aboard China's space station, has carried out scientific experiments and technical tests, extravehicular operations with application payloads, and science outreach work as planned. Marking the fifth Mid-Autumn Festival that Chinese astronauts have spent in space, the crew sent holiday greetings to people across the country from Tiangong.

title_en: Colorful Events Held Across China to Celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival
summary_en: People across China marked the Mid-Autumn Festival with a range of cultural and festive activities, from lantern-lit garden tours and chrysanthemum displays to boat rides along the Pinglu Canal in Guangxi and light shows in Beijing, Shanghai, Sichuan and Jilin. The segment also notes that September 25, 2026, marks the tenth anniversary of the completion of the FAST radio telescope in Pingtang, Guizhou, which has drawn a surge of visitors.

title_en: Exhibition Marking 90th Anniversary of Long March Victory Opens to Public Today
summary_en: The thematic exhibition "The Great Expedition — Commemorating the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March" opened to the public at the Military Museum of the Chinese People's Revolution in Beijing on September 25. Featuring 875 cultural relics (sets) and 186 documents, more than 300 of which are displayed for the first time, along with 14 classic historical scenes, the exhibition will remain open long-term as a permanent display, with visitors able to book tickets via the museum's WeChat service account.

title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Attend State Dinner Hosted by President Trump and Wife
summary_en: On the evening of September 24 local time, US President Donald Trump and his wife Melania hosted a state dinner at the White House for Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, during which Xi and Trump each delivered remarks. Earlier that day, Peng Liyuan and Melania Trump visited the National Museum of Asian Art in Washington.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with US President Trump
summary_en: On the morning of September 24 local time, President Xi Jinping held talks with US President Donald Trump at the White House, where they discussed building a constructive strategic stability relationship between China and the US, the new round of trade consultations, AI cooperation, and Taiwan, and exchanged views on the Middle East, Ukraine, and the Korean Peninsula.

title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Welcoming Ceremony Held by the U.S. President at the White House
summary_en: On the morning of September 24 local time, U.S. President Donald Trump held a grand ceremony at the White House to welcome Chinese President Xi Jinping on his state visit to the United States; both leaders delivered remarks, after which they reviewed the honor guard at the White House Rose Garden and held friendly exchanges in the Oval Office.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the UK returned 12 lost Chinese cultural relics and artworks at a handover ceremony at the Chinese Embassy in London on the 23rd; that Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Andrei Rudenko said Japan's "remilitarization" forced Russia to take defensive measures; and that Italy's Senate passed a bill authorizing the government to restart nuclear power generation.

title_en: International figures say Xi Jinping's written remarks push China and U.S. toward each other, injecting certainty into global development
summary_en: International figures said Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States is of great significance and that his written remarks on arrival were encouraging, expressing hope that under the strategic guidance of China-U.S. head-of-state diplomacy the two countries will strengthen coordination and positive interaction to improve the well-being of both peoples and add hope for world peace. They said Xi's written remarks injected stronger confidence into China-U.S. exchanges and cooperation and brought valuable certainty to world peace and development.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's cumulative installed power generation capacity reached 4.103 billion kilowatts by the end of August, up 11.1% year on year, with wind and solar combined at 1.992 billion kilowatts; that the Jiangyin-Jingjiang Yangtze River Tunnel and its north-south connecting roads officially opened to traffic; and that the film slate for the 2026 Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays and the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory was released in Beijing.

title_en: CMG Offers Festive Programming for Mid-Autumn Festival
summary_en: China Media Group is airing a range of Mid-Autumn Festival programming, including its 2026 Mid-Autumn Gala on the evening of the holiday across CCTV-1 and other platforms, along with specials such as "Home Among the Mountains and Waters," "Exploring Civilization Through Bronze and Stone," and the news channel's "Full Moon Over Golden Autumn."

title_en: 20th Asian Games: China Shines with Strong Performances, Rowing Team Wins 9 Golds in a Single Day
summary_en: At the 20th Asian Games, China won nine rowing golds in one day, plus two canoeing golds, six wushu sanda golds, two shooting team golds, Yang Yang's gold in the men's 60kg weightlifting, and a women's badminton team title over Japan. The women's gymnastics team also won gold, its 14th consecutive Asian Games title in the event.

title_en: Mid-Autumn and National Day Holidays Approaching: Cross-Regional Passenger Flows Expected to Remain at High Levels
summary_en: CCTV reports that during the Mid-Autumn holiday, cross-regional passenger trips across society are expected to reach 650 million, averaging about 220 million per day, while the seven-day National Day holiday is projected to see 2.13 billion trips, averaging 300 million per day, about 1.7 times normal levels, with the October 1 peak possibly setting a record for the period. Highway travel is expected to remain dominant at over 90 percent, with toll-free passage for small passenger cars from midnight October 1 to midnight October 7, and the National Immigration Administration forecasts average daily inbound and outbound passenger volumes of 2.25 million during Mid-Autumn and 2.15 million during National Day, peaking on September 25, September 27, October 1 and October 4.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: Advancing High-Quality Development of Culture and Tourism
